nodes.snippet: If you want your integrity never to leave you, guard your patience and live by it.

nodes.label: Kural 155
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who punish a wrong are counted as nothing. Those who bear it are wrapped up and kept like gold.

nodes.label: Kural 156
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who punish have one day’s pleasure. Those who bear it have renown until the end.

nodes.label: Kural 157
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if others do you wrongs that should never be done, it is good to suffer the pain and do nothing unrighteous.

nodes.label: Kural 158
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Defeat by your own worth those who wrong you in their arrogance.

nodes.label: Kural 159
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who can bear cruel words from the mouths of people who overstep are as pure as those who renounce the world.

nodes.label: Kural 160
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who fast and endure it are great, but they come after those who endure the cruel words of others.

nodes.label: Kural 161
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Make it your rule of conduct to keep your heart free of envy.

nodes.label: Kural 162
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you can be free of envy towards everyone, no great blessing equals it.

nodes.label: Kural 163
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever envies another’s prosperity and won’t welcome it wants no righteousness or prosperity of their own.

nodes.label: Kural 164
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who know the harm a bad path brings do nothing unrighteous out of envy.

nodes.label: Kural 165
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Envy alone is enough for the envious. Even if their enemies fail, it brings them ruin.

nodes.label: Kural 166
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever grudges what others are given, their kin will perish with nothing to wear and nothing to eat.

nodes.label: Kural 167
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The red goddess of fortune cannot bear the envious. She shows them to her elder sister and goes.

nodes.label: Kural 168
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: That sinner called envy destroys your wealth and sends you to an evil place.

nodes.label: Kural 169
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a crooked heart prospers and an upright person falls, it gives you something to think about.

nodes.label: Kural 170
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: No one has grown great through envy, and no one free of it has lost their prosperity.

nodes.label: Kural 171
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you lose your fairness and covet good wealth, it destroys your family and brings you faults then and there.

nodes.label: Kural 172
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those ashamed of unfairness won’t covet a gain and do what brings blame.

nodes.label: Kural 173
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who want that other joy won’t covet a small pleasure and do what is unrighteous.

nodes.label: Kural 174
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People who have conquered their senses and see without flaw don’t say “We have nothing” and covet.

nodes.label: Kural 175
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What use is a fine, wide understanding if you covet and do senseless things to anyone at all?

nodes.label: Kural 176
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who seeks compassion and stands on the path will perish if they covet wealth and plot evil.

nodes.label: Kural 177
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t want the gain that coveting brings. When it ripens, the fruit is hardly ever good.

nodes.label: Kural 178
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What keeps your wealth from shrinking? Not coveting the wealth in another’s hands.

nodes.label: Kural 179
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Fortune knows the way, and comes to the wise who know righteousness and don’t covet.

nodes.label: Kural 180
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Coveting without thought breeds destruction. The pride of wanting nothing breeds victory.

nodes.label: Kural 181
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if someone never speaks of righteousness and does wrong, it is good to have it said that they don’t backbite.

nodes.label: Kural 182
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Worse than destroying righteousness and doing wrong is to ruin someone behind their back and smile falsely to their face.

nodes.label: Kural 183
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Better to die than to live by backbiting and lies. Death brings the gain righteousness speaks of.

nodes.label: Kural 184
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you speak to someone’s face without mercy, don’t speak when they aren’t there, with no thought for what follows.

nodes.label: Kural 185
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: That someone’s heart isn’t in the righteousness they talk of can be seen from the meanness of their backbiting.

nodes.label: Kural 186
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever tells another’s faults will have their own picked out with care and told.

nodes.label: Kural 187
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who can’t make friends with words that bring smiles will speak words that divide, and drive friends apart.

nodes.label: Kural 188
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If it is their way to spread even the faults of those close to them, what will they do to strangers?

nodes.label: Kural 189
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Is it for righteousness’ sake that the earth bears the weight of someone who waits for your back to speak mean words?

nodes.label: Kural 190
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you could see your own faults as you see strangers’ faults, could any harm come to the enduring soul?

nodes.label: Kural 191
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever speaks useless words, to the disgust of many, is scorned by all.

nodes.label: Kural 192
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Saying useless things in front of many is worse than doing unkind things to your friends.

nodes.label: Kural 193
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Talk that spins out useless things says one thing by itself: the speaker has no goodness.

nodes.label: Kural 194
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Useless, graceless words said among many are unjust, and they take you away from all that is good.

nodes.label: Kural 195
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If people of good nature say useless things, their worth and the respect it brings will leave them.

nodes.label: Kural 196
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t call a person who keeps repeating useless words a human being. Call them chaff among people.

nodes.label: Kural 197
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Let the noble say things without goodness if they will. It is good that they say nothing useless.

nodes.label: Kural 198
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those wise enough to seek out rare gains won’t say words without great use.

nodes.label: Kural 199
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those of spotless sight, free of confusion, won’t say empty words even by a slip.

nodes.label: Kural 200
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Of words, say the ones with use. Of words, don’t say the ones without.

nodes.label: Kural 201
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who do evil don’t fear the arrogance called evil deeds. The worthy do.

nodes.label: Kural 202
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Evil things breed evil, so evil should be feared more than fire.

nodes.label: Kural 203
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say the highest of all wisdom is to do no evil even to those who hate you.

nodes.label: Kural 204
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t plot another’s ruin, even in a moment of forgetting. If you do, righteousness will plot yours.

nodes.label: Kural 205
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t do evil because you are poor. If you do, you will be poor again.

nodes.label: Kural 206
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you don’t want painful things to strike you down, don’t do evil things to others.

nodes.label: Kural 207
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: However fierce the enemy, people may escape. The enemy that is your own deed never goes away. It follows you and kills.

nodes.label: Kural 208
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The ruin of those who do evil is like a shadow that never leaves, and stays at their feet.

nodes.label: Kural 209
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you love yourself, don’t go near evil deeds at all, however small.

nodes.label: Kural 210
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Know that ruin is rare for anyone who doesn’t stray aside to do evil.

nodes.label: Kural 211
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Duty asks for no return. What does the world give back to the rain?

nodes.label: Kural 212
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All the wealth you earn by effort is for helping the worthy.

nodes.label: Kural 213
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In the world of the gods or here, it is hard to find anything better than helping others.

nodes.label: Kural 214
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever knows what is fitting is alive. Anyone else is counted among the dead.

nodes.label: Kural 215
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wealth of a person of great understanding who loves the world is like the village tank filled with water.

nodes.label: Kural 216
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When wealth falls to a good person, it is like a fruit tree ripening inside the village.

nodes.label: Kural 217
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When wealth falls to a person of great worth, it is like a tree that serves as medicine and never fails.

nodes.label: Kural 218
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when they have little room to give, those who know their duty won’t slacken in helping others.

nodes.label: Kural 219
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A good person’s poverty is this: being unable to rest when they can’t do what they must.

nodes.label: Kural 220
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If helping others brings ruin, that ruin is worth buying, even if you must sell up to do it.

nodes.label: Kural 221
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Only giving to those who have nothing is giving. All else is like a loan, measured out and paid back.

nodes.label: Kural 222
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if it were a good road, taking is bad. Even if there were no higher world, giving is good.

nodes.label: Kural 223
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Never speaking the misery of “I have nothing”, and giving: these belong only to those of good birth.

nodes.label: Kural 224
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Being begged from is painful, until you see the pleased face of the one who begged.

nodes.label: Kural 225
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The strength of the strong is to bear hunger. It comes after the strength of those who end that hunger.

nodes.label: Kural 226
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: End the ruinous hunger of those who have nothing. That is where someone who has wealth can store it.

nodes.label: Kural 227
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The evil disease called hunger will hardly touch someone used to sharing their food.

nodes.label: Kural 228
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Do they not know the joy of giving and being glad, those hard-hearted people who hoard what they own and lose it?

nodes.label: Kural 229
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Surely more painful than begging is eating alone what you have piled up.

nodes.label: Kural 230
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Nothing is more painful than dying. Even that is sweet when you can’t give.

nodes.label: Kural 231
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Give, and live with renown. There is no other gain for the soul.

nodes.label: Kural 232
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All that speakers say is renown, resting on those who give something to those who beg.

nodes.label: Kural 233
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Apart from matchless, towering renown, nothing in the world stands undying.

nodes.label: Kural 234
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If someone makes lasting renown within the bounds of the earth, the world of the gods will no longer honour the learned.

nodes.label: Kural 235
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruin that is gain, a death that is life: only the skilled can have these.

nodes.label: Kural 236
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you appear, appear with renown. For those without it, better not to appear at all.

nodes.label: Kural 237
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who can’t live with renown should blame themselves. Why blame those who scorn them?

nodes.label: Kural 238
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say it is a disgrace for everyone on earth not to gain the legacy called renown.

nodes.label: Kural 239
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Land that carries a body without renown will lose its rich, faultless yield.

nodes.label: Kural 240
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Only those who live free of disgrace are alive. Those who live without renown are not alive.

nodes.label: Kural 241
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wealth of compassion is the wealth among wealth. Wealth in goods is found even among the low.

nodes.label: Kural 242
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Search by good ways and hold to compassion. Test it by many ways, and it is still your only support.

nodes.label: Kural 243
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those whose hearts are full of compassion don’t enter the dark, painful world.

nodes.label: Kural 244
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say that those who tend living beings and hold to compassion have no deeds that make their own soul afraid.

nodes.label: Kural 245
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who hold to compassion have no misery. The great rich earth, where the wind moves, is witness.

nodes.label: Kural 246
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say that those who leave compassion and go on doing wrong have left what truly matters and forgotten.

nodes.label: Kural 247
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: That world is not for those without compassion, as this world is not for those without wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 248
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who lose wealth may flower again one day. Those who lose compassion are lost, and will hardly rise.

nodes.label: Kural 249
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Look closely at the righteousness done by someone without compassion. It is like a confused person glimpsing the truth.

nodes.label: Kural 250
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When you go against those weaker than you, think of yourself before those stronger.

nodes.label: Kural 251
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: How can someone who eats other flesh to swell their own hold to compassion?

nodes.label: Kural 252
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who don’t guard wealth don’t get to hold it. In the same way, those who eat flesh don’t get to hold compassion.

nodes.label: Kural 253
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Like the heart of someone holding a weapon, the mind of one who has tasted a creature’s body doesn’t turn to good.

nodes.label: Kural 254
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is compassion? Not killing. What is not? Killing. Eating that flesh is worthless.

nodes.label: Kural 255
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Life endures in not eating flesh. Eat it, and hell won’t open its mouth to let you out.

nodes.label: Kural 256
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If the world didn’t kill in order to eat, no one would offer flesh for money.

nodes.label: Kural 257
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Flesh is another creature’s wound. If you know that, you must not eat it.

nodes.label: Kural 258
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those whose sight has parted from fault won’t eat flesh that has parted from life.

nodes.label: Kural 259
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Better than pouring offerings into a thousand sacrifices is not to take one creature’s life and eat it.

nodes.label: Kural 260
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All living beings join their hands and worship one who doesn’t kill and refuses flesh.

nodes.label: Kural 261
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To bear the pain that comes to you and cause no pain to any living being: that is the form of austerity.

nodes.label: Kural 262
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Austerity comes to those who have austerity. For those without it, taking it up is in vain.

nodes.label: Kural 263
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Have the others forgotten austerity, in their wish to provide for those who have renounced?

nodes.label: Kural 264
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Crushing enemies and raising those who are dear: if you wish it, austerity can do both.

nodes.label: Kural 265
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Because what you want comes as you want it, austerity is striven for here.

nodes.label: Kural 266
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who do austerity do their own work. The rest are caught in craving and do what is in vain.

nodes.label: Kural 267
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Like gold that shines brighter the more it is burned, those who can endure shine brighter the more pain burns them.

nodes.label: Kural 268
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All other living beings worship someone who has wholly won their own soul.

nodes.label: Kural 269
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who have reached the strength that comes from austerity can even leap past death.

nodes.label: Kural 270
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Why are so many people without? Because few do austerity and many don’t.

nodes.label: Kural 271
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The five elements laugh to themselves at the hidden conduct of a deceitful mind.

nodes.label: Kural 272
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What use is a look as high as the sky if your own heart sinks into what you know is a fault?

nodes.label: Kural 273
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The strong look of someone with no strength is like a cow wearing a tiger’s skin to graze.

nodes.label: Kural 274
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To hide behind austerity and do wrong is like a hunter hiding in a bush to snare birds.

nodes.label: Kural 275
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The hidden conduct of those who say “We are free of attachment” brings many troubles, until they cry “What have we done?”

nodes.label: Kural 276
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: No one is crueller than those who don’t renounce in their hearts but live by deceit, as if they had renounced.

nodes.label: Kural 277
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world holds people red outside like the crab’s-eye seed, yet black inside, like its tip.

nodes.label: Kural 278
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Many people, the stain still in their minds, bathe to look worthy and live in hiding behind it.

nodes.label: Kural 279
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An arrow is cruel, a bent harp is true. Judge people the same way, by what they do.

nodes.label: Kural 280
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: No need for shaving or growing long hair, if you give up what the world condemns.

nodes.label: Kural 281
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever wants to be free of contempt must guard their heart from stealing anything at all.

nodes.label: Kural 282
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even to think it in your mind is evil: “We will steal another’s wealth by stealth.”

nodes.label: Kural 283
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Gain won by stealing seems to grow, then perishes beyond all measure.

nodes.label: Kural 284
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A hardened love of stealing, when it ripens, brings grief that never dies.

nodes.label: Kural 285
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To value compassion and have loving-kindness is not in those who want wealth and watch for others to slip.

nodes.label: Kural 286
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those with a hardened love of stealing can’t live within measure.

nodes.label: Kural 287
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The dark understanding called stealing isn’t found in those who want the strength called measure.

nodes.label: Kural 288
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: As righteousness stands in the hearts of those who know measure, deceit stands in the hearts of those who know stealing.

nodes.label: Kural 289
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who know nothing but stealing do what is beyond all measure, and perish on the spot.

nodes.label: Kural 290
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who steal, the body itself will fail. For those who don’t, even the world of the gods won’t fail.

nodes.label: Kural 291
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is truthfulness? It is speech with no harm in it at all.

nodes.label: Kural 292
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even a lie counts as truthfulness, if it brings good with no fault in it.

nodes.label: Kural 293
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t lie about what your own heart knows. Once you have lied, your own heart will burn you.

nodes.label: Kural 294
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Live without lying in your heart, and you will live in the hearts of all the world.

nodes.label: Kural 295
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you speak truth from the heart, you stand above those who practise penance and give alms as well.

nodes.label: Kural 296
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: There is no renown like never lying. Without any toil, it gives you all righteousness.

nodes.label: Kural 297
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you can keep to not lying, not lying, then it is good to leave other righteous deeds undone, quite undone.

nodes.label: Kural 298
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Water gives you outer purity. Inner purity is seen through truthfulness.

nodes.label: Kural 299
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Not every lamp is a lamp. To the worthy, the only lamp is the lamp of not lying.

nodes.label: Kural 300
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Of all we have seen to be true, nothing at all is better than truthfulness.

nodes.label: Kural 301
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever holds back anger where it can take effect truly holds it back. Where it can’t, what does it matter if you hold it back or not?

nodes.label: Kural 302
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Anger is bad where it can’t take effect. Where it can, nothing is worse.

nodes.label: Kural 303
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Forget your anger, whoever it is against. Evil things are born of it.

nodes.label: Kural 304
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Anger kills your smile and your joy. What other enemy is there?

nodes.label: Kural 305
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you would guard yourself, guard against anger. If you don’t, it is you that anger kills.

nodes.label: Kural 306
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Anger, the killer of those who come near it, burns the raft of safety that is your own people.

nodes.label: Kural 307
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who prizes anger will be ruined, as surely as a hand that strikes the ground can’t escape.

nodes.label: Kural 308
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if someone hurts you as a mass of flame would, it is good not to be angry, if you can.

nodes.label: Kural 309
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you never even think of anger in your heart, all you have thought of will come to you at once.

nodes.label: Kural 310
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those far gone in anger are like the dead. Those who renounce anger are the equals of renouncers.

nodes.label: Kural 311
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Doing no harm to others, even for wealth that brings high standing, is the rule of those without stain.

nodes.label: Kural 312
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Not harming in return, even when someone has harmed you in hatred, is the rule of those without stain.

nodes.label: Kural 313
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you harm even those who hated you when you had done nothing to them, it brings you misery you can’t escape.

nodes.label: Kural 314
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The way to punish those who harm you is to do them such good that they are ashamed, and then let it go.

nodes.label: Kural 315
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What good is your understanding, if you don’t guard against another’s pain as you would your own?

nodes.label: Kural 316
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What you know to be painful, you must not do to anyone else.

nodes.label: Kural 317
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Doing no wilful harm, in any measure, at any time, to anyone, is the highest thing.

nodes.label: Kural 318
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You know what harm feels like to your own life. Why, then, do you harm other lives?

nodes.label: Kural 319
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Harm others in the morning, and harm will come to you in the afternoon, by itself.

nodes.label: Kural 320
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All pain falls on those who cause pain. Those who want to be free of pain cause none.

nodes.label: Kural 321
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is righteous action? Not killing. Killing brings with it every action of the other kind.

nodes.label: Kural 322
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Sharing your food and caring for many living things is first among everything the learned have gathered.

nodes.label: Kural 323
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Not killing stands alone as good. Next after it, not lying is good.

nodes.label: Kural 324
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is called the good path? The way that takes care to kill nothing at all.

nodes.label: Kural 325
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Among all who dread the state they are in and renounce, the highest is the one who dreads killing and keeps to not killing.

nodes.label: Kural 326
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Death, which eats lives, won’t come upon the days of someone who holds to not killing.

nodes.label: Kural 327
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you lose your own life for it, don’t do what takes another sweet life.

nodes.label: Kural 328
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if the gain is great and good, to the worthy, gain that comes from killing is the lowest thing.

nodes.label: Kural 329
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People who live by killing are, in the minds of those who can see baseness, doing unclean work.

nodes.label: Kural 330
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say that those living a poor, wretched life in diseased bodies are those who took life from bodies.

nodes.label: Kural 331
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Having the petty mind that takes what doesn’t last for what lasts is the lowest state.

nodes.label: Kural 332
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Great wealth comes like the crowd at a dance. It goes the way that crowd goes when the dance is over.

nodes.label: Kural 333
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: It is the nature of wealth not to stay. When you get it, do at once the things that stay.

nodes.label: Kural 334
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: It shows itself as something called a day, but it is a blade sawing through life, if you can find anyone who sees it.

nodes.label: Kural 335
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Before your tongue is stilled and the hiccup rises, rush to do good deeds.

nodes.label: Kural 336
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: This world has this greatness: a man was here yesterday and is gone today.

nodes.label: Kural 337
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They can’t be sure of living one moment more, yet they think thoughts by the ten million, and more.

nodes.label: Kural 338
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The friendship between body and soul is like a bird that flies off and leaves the egg lying alone.

nodes.label: Kural 339
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Death is like falling asleep. Birth is like waking after sleep.

nodes.label: Kural 340
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The soul has been lodging in the body. Has it still found no home of its own?

nodes.label: Kural 341
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: From each thing you have let go of, you suffer no more pain.

nodes.label: Kural 342
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you want them, renounce while you can. Once you have renounced, many things are yours here.

nodes.label: Kural 343
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You must crush the hold of the five senses and give up, all together, everything you wanted.

nodes.label: Kural 344
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Having nothing at all is the way of penance. Owning even one thing brings back delusion.

nodes.label: Kural 345
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those out to cut off birth, even the body is too much. Why then any other ties?

nodes.label: Kural 346
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever cuts away the pride that says “I” and “mine” will enter a world higher than the gods’.

nodes.label: Kural 347
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Suffering holds on and won’t let go of those who hold on to attachment and won’t let go.

nodes.label: Kural 348
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who renounce completely have arrived. All others are deluded, and caught in a net.

nodes.label: Kural 349
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The moment attachment ends, birth is cut off. Otherwise you will see impermanence.

nodes.label: Kural 350
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Hold to the attachment of the one who has no attachment. Hold to that attachment, so that you can let go of attachment.

nodes.label: Kural 351
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A wretched birth comes from the delusion that takes what isn’t real for what is.

nodes.label: Kural 352
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who have left delusion behind and see without stain, darkness goes and joy comes.

nodes.label: Kural 353
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who have left doubt behind and see clearly, heaven is nearer than the earth.

nodes.label: Kural 354
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you have mastered the awareness of the five senses, there is no gain in it without knowledge of the truth.

nodes.label: Kural 355
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whatever a thing may be, and however it may seem, understanding is seeing the reality in it.

nodes.label: Kural 356
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who learn here and see the truth will reach the path that doesn’t come back here.

nodes.label: Kural 357
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If your mind examines and surely knows what truly is, you need not think of being born again.

nodes.label: Kural 358
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To end the folly called birth and see the pure reality called excellence: that is understanding.

nodes.label: Kural 359
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you know what to rest on and live so that attachment dies, the ills that would come to you are destroyed and won’t come.

nodes.label: Kural 360
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When even the names of these three, desire, anger and delusion, are gone, pain is gone.

nodes.label: Kural 361
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say craving is the seed that yields, for all living things at all times, birth that never ends.

nodes.label: Kural 362
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you must want something, want not to be born. That comes from wanting to want nothing.

nodes.label: Kural 363
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: There is no great wealth here to match wanting nothing. Even there, nothing equals it.

nodes.label: Kural 364
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Purity is having no craving. That comes from wanting truthfulness.

nodes.label: Kural 365
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who are called free are the ones free of craving. The others are not free in the same way.

nodes.label: Kural 366
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Craving is what deceives you. To fear it is righteousness.

nodes.label: Kural 367
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you cut off craving completely, deeds that never fail you will come the way you want them.

nodes.label: Kural 368
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those without craving have no suffering. Where it exists, suffering comes on and on, without end.

nodes.label: Kural 369
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Destroy craving, the worst suffering of all, and joy goes on unbroken, even here.

nodes.label: Kural 370
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you give up craving, whose nature is never to be filled, that very moment gives you a nature that never changes.

nodes.label: Kural 371
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The fate that brings you wealth also brings the drive to work. The fate that takes it away brings laziness.

nodes.label: Kural 372
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Fate that is taking things from you makes you foolish. Fate that is bringing you gain widens your mind.

nodes.label: Kural 373
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You may study many subtle books, yet the understanding you were born with still wins out.

nodes.label: Kural 374
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world runs two separate ways: being rich is one thing, being wise is another.

nodes.label: Kural 375
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When making money, everything that should help can go wrong, and everything that should hurt can turn out well.

nodes.label: Kural 376
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What isn’t yours by fate won’t stay, however hard you guard it. What is yours won’t leave, even if you throw it out.

nodes.label: Kural 377
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even someone who has piled up millions can enjoy only what fate has allotted.

nodes.label: Kural 378
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The poor would renounce the world, if only fate didn’t make them live out the suffering still due to them.

nodes.label: Kural 379
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you welcome good times as good, why be distressed when the bad ones come?

nodes.label: Kural 380
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is stronger than fate? Even as you plan a way around it, it gets there first.

nodes.label: Kural 381
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An army, people, food, ministers, friends and forts: whoever has all six is a bull among rulers.

nodes.label: Kural 382
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Fearlessness, giving, understanding and drive: a ruler’s nature is never to lack these four.

nodes.label: Kural 383
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Wakefulness, learning and resolve: these three never leave those who rule the land.

nodes.label: Kural 384
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler keeps to righteousness, removes what is wrong, and has an honour that never slips from valour.

nodes.label: Kural 385
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler is one who can create, gather and guard, and share out what is guarded.

nodes.label: Kural 386
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If a ruler is easy to see and not harsh in speech, his land will be praised above all others.

nodes.label: Kural 387
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever can give and protect with sweet words will find the world is just as their own word would have it.

nodes.label: Kural 388
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler who does justice and protects will be held the lord of his people.

nodes.label: Kural 389
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world rests under the umbrella of a ruler with the character to bear words bitter to his ears.

nodes.label: Kural 390
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Giving, kindness, a straight sceptre and care for the people: a ruler with these four is a light among rulers.

nodes.label: Kural 391
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Learn what should be learned, and learn it without flaw. Once you have learned it, live up to it.

nodes.label: Kural 392
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What they call numbers and what they call letters: these two, they say, are the eyes of those who live.

nodes.label: Kural 393
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those said to have eyes are the learned. The unlearned have two sores on their faces.

nodes.label: Kural 394
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To meet so that people are glad, and to part so that they long to meet again: that is the way of the learned.

nodes.label: Kural 395
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Some learn, though it means yearning like the poor before the rich. Those who don’t learn are the lowest.

nodes.label: Kural 396
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A well in the sand gives water as far as you dig. People’s understanding flows as far as they learn.

nodes.label: Kural 397
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To the learned, every country is their country and every town their town. Why then does anyone go without learning until they die?

nodes.label: Kural 398
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What you learn in one birth shelters you for seven.

nodes.label: Kural 399
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Seeing that the world delights in what delights them, the learned desire it all the more.

nodes.label: Kural 400
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Learning is the great wealth that can’t be destroyed. All else is not wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 401
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Speaking in an assembly without having studied fully is like playing at counters with no board.

nodes.label: Kural 402
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An unlearned man’s desire to speak is like a woman with no breasts at all desiring womanhood.

nodes.label: Kural 403
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even the unlearned are very good, if they can keep from speaking in front of the learned.

nodes.label: Kural 404
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when an unlearned man’s cleverness is very good, the wise don’t accept it.

nodes.label: Kural 405
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An unlearned man’s standing falls away when he comes face to face with others and speaks.

nodes.label: Kural 406
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All you can say of the unlearned is that they exist. They are like salt land that yields nothing.

nodes.label: Kural 407
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The fine looks of a man with no subtle, searching mind are like those of a well-made clay doll.

nodes.label: Kural 408
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Wealth in the hands of the unlearned is worse than poverty falling on the good.

nodes.label: Kural 409
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The unlearned, though born high, don’t have the standing of the learned, though born low.

nodes.label: Kural 410
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: As beasts are to humans, so others are to those who have learned bright books.

nodes.label: Kural 411
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wealth of wealth is the wealth of the ear. That wealth is first among all wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 412
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When there is no food for the ear, give the stomach a little too.

nodes.label: Kural 413
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who have listening, the food of the ear, are on this earth the equals of the gods who feed on offerings.

nodes.label: Kural 414
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you have no learning, listen. It will be a prop to lean on when you falter.

nodes.label: Kural 415
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The words of people of good conduct are like a staff on slippery ground.

nodes.label: Kural 416
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Listen to good things, however little. Even that little will bring you full greatness.

nodes.label: Kural 417
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when they have misunderstood, those who have studied closely and gathered much listening don’t speak folly.

nodes.label: Kural 418
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Ears not pierced by listening are deaf, even though they hear.

nodes.label: Kural 419
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those without subtle listening can hardly have humble mouths.

nodes.label: Kural 420
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People who know the tastes of the mouth but not the tastes of the ear: what does it matter if they die or live?

nodes.label: Kural 421
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Understanding is a tool that guards against ruin, and a fort inside that even enemies can’t destroy.

nodes.label: Kural 422
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Understanding doesn’t let the mind go wherever it goes. It turns it from evil and guides it to good.

nodes.label: Kural 423
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whatever you hear, from whoever’s mouth, understanding is seeing the reality in it.

nodes.label: Kural 424
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Understanding is saying things so that they go home and are easy to grasp, and seeing the subtle meaning in what others say.

nodes.label: Kural 425
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To embrace the world is cleverness. Not to bloom and then close is understanding.

nodes.label: Kural 426
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: However the world lives, understanding is living that way with the world.

nodes.label: Kural 427
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those with understanding know what will be. Those without it can’t know that.

nodes.label: Kural 428
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Not to fear what should be feared is folly. To fear what should be feared is the way of those who understand.

nodes.label: Kural 429
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those with the understanding to guard against what is to come have no suffering that comes and shakes them.

nodes.label: Kural 430
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those with understanding have everything. Those without it, whatever they have, have nothing.

nodes.label: Kural 431
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those without pride, anger or pettiness have a prosperity with greatness in it.

nodes.label: Kural 432
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Miserliness, honour that has lost its nobility, and joy with no measure are faults in a ruler.

nodes.label: Kural 433
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who fear blame treat even a fault the size of a millet seed as if it were as big as a palmyra tree.

nodes.label: Kural 434
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Guard against fault as your one aim. Fault is the enemy that brings your end.

nodes.label: Kural 435
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who doesn’t guard in advance will see their life perish, like a stack of straw before a fire.

nodes.label: Kural 436
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If a ruler removes his own faults first, and then looks at those of others, what fault can he have?

nodes.label: Kural 437
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wealth of a miser who leaves undone what should be done won’t stay. It will perish.

nodes.label: Kural 438
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The miserliness called a clinging heart is not to be counted with anything else.

nodes.label: Kural 439
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Never admire yourself. Don’t set your heart on deeds that bring no good.

nodes.label: Kural 440
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you can enjoy what you love without letting your love be known, the schemes of your enemies are useless.

nodes.label: Kural 441
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Learn how it is done, then choose with care the friendship of the wise, who know righteousness and have grown old in it.

nodes.label: Kural 442
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Cherish and keep close those who can end the suffering that has come and guard against it before it comes.

nodes.label: Kural 443
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Of all rare things the rarest is to cherish the great and make them your own.

nodes.label: Kural 444
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Conducting yourself so that those greater than you become your own people is the highest of all strengths.

nodes.label: Kural 445
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler goes forward with his advisers as his eyes, so he should choose them with care.

nodes.label: Kural 446
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you keep worthy company and can conduct yourself well, there is nothing your enemies can do to you.

nodes.label: Kural 447
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you keep companions who will rebuke you, who has the power to ruin you?

nodes.label: Kural 448
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler with no one to rebuke him has no protection, and will fall even with no one to bring him down.

nodes.label: Kural 449
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Without capital there is no profit. Without a prop to lean on there is no standing firm.

nodes.label: Kural 450
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Letting go of your bond with good people is ten times worse than making enemies of many.

nodes.label: Kural 451
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Greatness fears petty company. Pettiness treats it as kin.

nodes.label: Kural 452
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Water changes and takes on the nature of the ground it meets. People’s understanding takes on the nature of their company.

nodes.label: Kural 453
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What a person perceives comes from their mind. What people call them comes from their company.

nodes.label: Kural 454
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A person’s understanding seems to be in their mind, but it lies in their company.

nodes.label: Kural 455
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A pure mind and pure deeds both depend on pure company.

nodes.label: Kural 456
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What the pure of mind leave behind is good. For those in pure company, no deed fails to turn out well.

nodes.label: Kural 457
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A good mind brings living beings prosperity. Good company brings every kind of glory.

nodes.label: Kural 458
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even the noble, though their minds are thoroughly good, find protection in good company.

nodes.label: Kural 459
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The next world comes from a good mind, and even that finds its protection in good company.

nodes.label: Kural 460
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: There is no help greater than good company, and nothing causes more grief than bad company.

nodes.label: Kural 461
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Weigh what will be lost, what will be gained, and the profit it will bring later, then act.

nodes.label: Kural 462
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who examine a task with people they have chosen, think it over and then act, nothing is out of reach.

nodes.label: Kural 463
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wise won’t start a venture that looks for profit and loses the capital.

nodes.label: Kural 464
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who fear the stain of disgrace won’t begin what they are not sure of.

nodes.label: Kural 465
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To march out without thinking through every side of it is a way of planting your enemies in a prepared bed.

nodes.label: Kural 466
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You are ruined by doing what should not be done. You are ruined too by not doing what should.

nodes.label: Kural 467
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Think, then commit to the task. To say you will think after you have committed is a mistake.

nodes.label: Kural 468
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Effort not made the right way will crack, though many stand by to guard it.

nodes.label: Kural 469
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even doing good can go wrong, if you don’t do it knowing each person’s nature.

nodes.label: Kural 470
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Think first, and do what no one will scorn. The world won’t accept what doesn’t suit you.

nodes.label: Kural 471
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Weigh the strength of the task, your own strength, your enemy’s strength and the strength of allies, then act.

nodes.label: Kural 472
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who know what they can do, know what must be known, and stay fixed on it as they go, nothing is out of reach.

nodes.label: Kural 473
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Many, not knowing the strength they have, set out on a surge of zeal and broke halfway.

nodes.label: Kural 474
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who won’t live at peace, don’t know their measure and admire themselves are quickly ruined.

nodes.label: Kural 475
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even a cart loaded with peacock feathers will break its axle, if you pile them too high.

nodes.label: Kural 476
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who have climbed to the tip of a branch and try to go further will lose their life.

nodes.label: Kural 477
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Give in the right way, knowing your limit. That is how to look after your wealth as you spend it.

nodes.label: Kural 478
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The way in may be narrow, but there is no harm, as long as the way out is no wider.

nodes.label: Kural 479
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A life not lived within its limit seems to be there, then is not, then vanishes without a trace.

nodes.label: Kural 480
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Helping others without weighing what you have will quickly destroy your wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 481
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: By day the crow beats the owl. Rulers who would beat their enemies need the right time.

nodes.label: Kural 482
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Acting in step with the season is a rope that ties good fortune down so that it can’t leave.

nodes.label: Kural 483
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Is any task hard, if you have the means and know the time?

nodes.label: Kural 484
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you aim at the whole world, it will come into your hands, if you act with an eye to the time and the place.

nodes.label: Kural 485
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who have their eye on the world stay still, unshaken, and watch for the time.

nodes.label: Kural 486
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a person of spirit holds back, it is like a fighting ram drawing back to charge.

nodes.label: Kural 487
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wise don’t flare up outwardly on the spot. They watch for the time and burn within.

nodes.label: Kural 488
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When you see your enemies, carry them. When you see their end, they will fall head first.

nodes.label: Kural 489
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When what is hard to come by comes your way, do at that very moment what is hard to do.

nodes.label: Kural 490
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In the time for holding still, be like the heron. When your moment comes, be like its strike.

nodes.label: Kural 491
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Start nothing and scorn no one until you have found the ground for a siege.

nodes.label: Kural 492
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even to the strong and warlike, a gain that rests on a stronghold brings many benefits.

nodes.label: Kural 493
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even the weak grow strong and win, if they know the place, guard themselves and act against their enemies.

nodes.label: Kural 494
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who had it all planned lose their plan, when the other side learns the place, closes in and acts.

nodes.label: Kural 495
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In deep water the crocodile beats everything. Out of the water, everything else beats it.

nodes.label: Kural 496
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Tall chariots with strong wheels can’t run on the sea. Ships that run on the sea can’t run on land.

nodes.label: Kural 497
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You need no help but fearlessness, if you think everything through and act to suit the place.

nodes.label: Kural 498
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When the one with a small army reaches ground that suits it, the one with a great army loses heart.

nodes.label: Kural 499
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if they lack good defences and renown, it is hard to attack people on the land where they live.

nodes.label: Kural 500
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fearless tusker with spearmen on its tusks can be killed by a jackal, in mud where its legs sink.

nodes.label: Kural 501
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Test someone by these four, righteousness, wealth, pleasure and fear for their life, and then trust them.

nodes.label: Kural 502
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Trust the one who is born of good family, free of faults, and has the shame that dreads a scar.

nodes.label: Kural 503
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even among those who have learned hard things and have no flaw, look closely and you will rarely find anyone with no ignorance at all.

nodes.label: Kural 504
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Look at their good points, look at their faults, see which are more, and judge them by that.

nodes.label: Kural 505
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For a person’s greatness or smallness, their own deeds are the touchstone.

nodes.label: Kural 506
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Do not trust those who have no one. They have no ties and feel no shame at blame.

nodes.label: Kural 507
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To trust those who don’t know what they should, leaning on your fondness for them, brings every kind of folly.

nodes.label: Kural 508
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Trust a stranger without testing them, and the suffering won’t end, even for those who come after you.

nodes.label: Kural 509
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Trust no one without testing them. After testing, trust them with what they can be trusted with.

nodes.label: Kural 510
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To trust without testing, and to doubt someone you have come to trust, both bring suffering that doesn’t end.

nodes.label: Kural 511
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The one who looks at both the good and the bad, and whose nature is to choose the good, is the one to employ.

nodes.label: Kural 512
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Let the work go to the one who can widen the sources of income, build up prosperity and look into whatever trouble comes.

nodes.label: Kural 513
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Place your trust in the one who truly has these four: loving-kindness, understanding, firmness and freedom from craving.

nodes.label: Kural 514
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even after you have trusted them in every way, many people change with the nature of the work.

nodes.label: Kural 515
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Work is not something to hand to a favourite. It goes only to one who knows how and can endure to the end.

nodes.label: Kural 516
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Look closely at the doer, look closely at the work, match them to the time, and then act.

nodes.label: Kural 517
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Work out that this person can finish this task by this means, then leave it in their hands.

nodes.label: Kural 518
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Once you have found someone right for a task, make that task theirs.

nodes.label: Kural 519
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you misread the closeness of someone devoted to the work, good fortune will leave you.

nodes.label: Kural 520
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Let the ruler look into it every day. If the one who does the work doesn’t go crooked, the world won’t.

nodes.label: Kural 521
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Only kin go on cherishing old ties even when you have lost everything.

nodes.label: Kural 522
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you have kin whose fondness never ends, they will bring you many gains that go on sprouting.

nodes.label: Kural 523
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A life with no sharing of hearts is like a broad tank filling with water and no bank around it.

nodes.label: Kural 524
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The reward of having wealth is to live so that your kin gather round you.

nodes.label: Kural 525
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you can give and speak sweetly, you will be surrounded by kin, rank upon rank.

nodes.label: Kural 526
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: No one on this wide earth has more people at their side than a great giver who doesn’t cherish anger.

nodes.label: Kural 527
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The crow doesn’t hide its food. It calls the others and eats. Gains come only to those with a nature like that.

nodes.label: Kural 528
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If a ruler looks on people not all alike but each by their rank, many will live by that regard.

nodes.label: Kural 529
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who were your own and left you will come back as kin, once the cause of the rift is gone.

nodes.label: Kural 530
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When someone who left comes back for a reason, a ruler should meet that reason, think it through and take them in.

nodes.label: Kural 531
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Worse than boundless rage is the carelessness that comes from the high spirits of great delight.

nodes.label: Kural 532
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Carelessness kills glory, as daily want kills understanding.

nodes.label: Kural 533
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: There is no glory for the careless. The learned of every kind in the world agree on that.

nodes.label: Kural 534
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: There is no fort for those who are afraid. Just so, there is no good for the careless.

nodes.label: Kural 535
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: One who fails to guard in advance will regret that mistake when the blow lands.

nodes.label: Kural 536
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you can keep from slipping, with everyone, at all times, without fail, nothing else compares.

nodes.label: Kural 537
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Nothing is too hard to do, if you take care and use the tool of unbroken attention.

nodes.label: Kural 538
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Hold to what is praised and do it. Those who scorn it and don’t do it have nothing, in all seven births.

nodes.label: Kural 539
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When your delight makes you feel strong, remember those who were ruined by neglect.

nodes.label: Kural 540
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Getting what you have set your mind on is easy, if you can keep your mind on it.

nodes.label: Kural 541
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To look into it, show no favour to anyone, hold to fairness and act after weighing it: that is justice.

nodes.label: Kural 542
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All the world lives looking to the sky. A ruler’s people live looking to his sceptre.

nodes.label: Kural 543
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The ruler’s sceptre stands at the root of the books of the sages and of righteousness.

nodes.label: Kural 544
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world clings to the feet of the great ruler who holds his people close and wields the sceptre.

nodes.label: Kural 545
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Rain and harvest come together in the land of a ruler who wields the sceptre as it should be wielded.

nodes.label: Kural 546
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: It is not the spear that brings a ruler victory. It is the sceptre, and that only if it doesn’t bend.

nodes.label: Kural 547
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The ruler guards the whole world. Justice guards him, if he keeps it up without a break.

nodes.label: Kural 548
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler who isn’t easy to reach, and doesn’t look into things and give justice, will sink low and fall by himself.

nodes.label: Kural 549
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To protect his people from others, care for them and punish wrongdoing is no stain on a ruler. It is his work.

nodes.label: Kural 550
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler who punishes the wicked with death is like someone pulling weeds from a green crop.

nodes.label: Kural 551
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler who takes to tormenting people and doing wrong is crueller than those who have taken up killing.

nodes.label: Kural 552
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When one who stands with a sceptre asks, it is like one who stands with a spear saying, “Hand it over.”

nodes.label: Kural 553
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a ruler doesn’t look into things daily and do justice, his land goes to ruin day by day.

nodes.label: Kural 554
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler who bends the sceptre and acts without thinking will lose his riches and his people together.

nodes.label: Kural 555
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The tears wept by those who suffer and can’t bear it: are they not the weapon that wears away wealth?

nodes.label: Kural 556
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What makes rulers last is the straight sceptre. Without it, their light won’t last.

nodes.label: Kural 557
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What no rain is to the earth, a ruler with no tenderness is to living beings.

nodes.label: Kural 558
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Under the sceptre of a ruler who does no justice, having is more painful than having nothing.

nodes.label: Kural 559
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If the ruler acts against justice, the sky will fail its season and won’t rain.

nodes.label: Kural 560
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If the protector doesn’t protect, cows give less and those of the six duties forget their books.

nodes.label: Kural 561
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler is one who looks into a wrong fairly and punishes to fit it, so that it won’t be done again.

nodes.label: Kural 562
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Raise the blow sharply but let it land softly, if you want your gains to stay with you for long.

nodes.label: Kural 563
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A wielder of the cruel sceptre, who lives by what terrifies people, is sure to fall, and soon.

nodes.label: Kural 564
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler of whom people say the bitter words “Our ruler is harsh” will see his days shortened and soon fall.

nodes.label: Kural 565
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The great wealth of someone hard to see, with a sour face, is like something a demon has laid eyes on.

nodes.label: Kural 566
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you have a harsh tongue and no kind eye, even vast wealth will perish at once, without lasting.

nodes.label: Kural 567
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Harsh words and punishment past all measure are the file that wears away a ruler’s conquering strength.

nodes.label: Kural 568
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If a ruler who doesn’t think things through with his circle flies into a rage, his good fortune shrinks.

nodes.label: Kural 569
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler who doesn’t build defences before war comes will take fright when it does, and quickly fall.

nodes.label: Kural 570
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A harsh sceptre binds the unlearned to itself. The earth has no burden but that.

nodes.label: Kural 571
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: This world exists because of the surpassing beauty called kindly regard.

nodes.label: Kural 572
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The way of the world rests on kindly regard. Those without it exist only as a burden on the earth.

nodes.label: Kural 573
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What use is a melody that doesn’t fit the song? What use is an eye without kindly regard?

nodes.label: Kural 574
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Eyes without kindly regard, in due measure, only seem to be there in the face. What else do they do?

nodes.label: Kural 575
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Kindly regard is the eye’s jewel. Without it, an eye is taken for a sore.

nodes.label: Kural 576
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People who have eyes, yet whose eyes never turn kindly to others, are like trees fixed in the soil.

nodes.label: Kural 577
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those without kindly regard have no eyes. Those who have eyes are never without it.

nodes.label: Kural 578
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: This world belongs to those who can show kindly regard without ruining the work they must do.

nodes.label: Kural 579
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even with people whose way is to hurt you, the highest quality is to show kindly regard and put up with it.

nodes.label: Kural 580
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who want the courtesy everyone admires will watch poison being poured, drink it and stay content.

nodes.label: Kural 581
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Spies and books of high repute: a ruler should be clear that these two are his eyes.

nodes.label: Kural 582
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To know quickly, every day, all that happens to everyone is a ruler’s work.

nodes.label: Kural 583
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler who doesn’t spy through his spies and weigh what they find has no road to victory.

nodes.label: Kural 584
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A spy is someone who watches everyone alike: those who do your work, your own kin, and those who wish you ill.

nodes.label: Kural 585
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A spy is someone with a look that draws no suspicion, who doesn’t flinch under a stare, and who never lets anything spill.

nodes.label: Kural 586
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A spy takes the form of those who have renounced, goes where others can’t and searches, and gives nothing away, whatever is done to them.

nodes.label: Kural 587
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A spy is someone who can hear what has been hidden, and has no doubt about what they have learned.

nodes.label: Kural 588
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What one spy has spied out and brought you, have another spy find out too.

nodes.label: Kural 589
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Use spies so that one spy doesn’t know another. When three agree, believe it.

nodes.label: Kural 590
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t honour a spy where others can see. If you do, you have brought your own secret out into the open.

nodes.label: Kural 591
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Drive is what truly counts as having. Do those without it really have whatever else they have?

nodes.label: Kural 592
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To have spirit is to truly have something. Having wealth doesn’t last. It slips away.

nodes.label: Kural 593
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who hold lasting drive in their hand don’t fret, saying “Our prosperity is lost.”

nodes.label: Kural 594
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Prosperity asks the way and goes by itself to someone whose drive never wavers.

nodes.label: Kural 595
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The stem of a water flower is as long as the water is deep. People rise as high as their spirit.

nodes.label: Kural 596
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Let all your thoughts be of rising higher. Even when it fails, it has the nature of not failing.

nodes.label: Kural 597
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The strong don’t falter when things fall apart. An elephant struck by a mass of arrows stands its ground.

nodes.label: Kural 598
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those without spirit will never have the pride of thinking, “In this world, we are the generous ones.”

nodes.label: Kural 599
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An elephant may be huge and sharp of tusk, yet it fears a tiger’s attack.

nodes.label: Kural 600
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A person’s strength is wealth of spirit. Those without it are trees. Only their human shape sets them apart.

nodes.label: Kural 601
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The unfailing lamp called family goes out and is lost when the grime called laziness creeps over it.

nodes.label: Kural 602
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who want their family to be a true family should treat laziness as the laziness it is.

nodes.label: Kural 603
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The family of a fool who carries laziness within will perish before the fool does.

nodes.label: Kural 604
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who fall into laziness and make no fine effort, the family dies and faults multiply.

nodes.label: Kural 605
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Delay, forgetfulness, laziness and sleep: these four are the boat that those bound for ruin desire.

nodes.label: Kural 606
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when they hold all that the lords of the earth hold, the lazy won’t easily win any great good.

nodes.label: Kural 607
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who love laziness and make no fine effort will hear words of rebuke and scorn.

nodes.label: Kural 608
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If laziness settles in someone of good family, it will make them a slave to their enemies.

nodes.label: Kural 609
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a man ends the rule of laziness over him, the faults that have entered his family and his manhood are gone.

nodes.label: Kural 610
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A ruler free of laziness will gain, all at once, everything the one who measured with his feet strode over.

nodes.label: Kural 611
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t lose heart and say “This is too hard.” Effort will give you greatness.

nodes.label: Kural 612
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In any work, take care not to let the work fail. The world leaves those who leave work undone.

nodes.label: Kural 613
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The pride called helping others rests in the fine quality called effort.

nodes.label: Kural 614
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Helping others, in someone without effort, will come to nothing, like a sword in a eunuch’s hand.

nodes.label: Kural 615
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who wants work, not pleasure, wipes away their kin’s suffering and is the pillar that holds them up.

nodes.label: Kural 616
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Effort builds prosperity. Lack of effort lets want in.

nodes.label: Kural 617
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say dark Misfortune lives in laziness, and she of the lotus in the effort of those without it.

nodes.label: Kural 618
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The lack of a favouring fate disgraces no one. The disgrace is to know what must be known and make no effort.

nodes.label: Kural 619
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if god won’t allow it, effort pays the wages of your body’s toil.

nodes.label: Kural 620
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who strive without faltering and without delay will see the back of fate itself.

nodes.label: Kural 621
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Laugh when trouble comes. Nothing presses on it and rides it down like that.

nodes.label: Kural 622
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even a flood of trouble dies away once a wise person sets their mind to it.

nodes.label: Kural 623
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who aren’t troubled by trouble will give trouble trouble.

nodes.label: Kural 624
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Trouble itself is in trouble when it meets someone who, like an ox, pulls through every blocked place.

nodes.label: Kural 625
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if they come heaped one on another, the troubles that reach an unbroken person are themselves in trouble.

nodes.label: Kural 626
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Will those who never clung to what they gained, saying “We have got it,” grieve and say “We have lost it”?

nodes.label: Kural 627
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who know the body is a target for suffering don’t treat the turmoil that comes on them as distress.

nodes.label: Kural 628
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who doesn’t crave pleasure, and says suffering is natural, never comes to sorrow.

nodes.label: Kural 629
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who doesn’t crave joy in times of joy won’t feel sorrow in times of sorrow.

nodes.label: Kural 630
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you take what hurts as joy, you will have the distinction your enemies prize.

nodes.label: Kural 631
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A minister is someone who excels in the means, the time, the method and the rare work to be done.

nodes.label: Kural 632
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Firmness, guarding the people, learning and knowing, and effort: a minister excels in all five.

nodes.label: Kural 633
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A minister is someone who can split others apart, keep friends close, and bring back those who have split away.

nodes.label: Kural 634
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A minister is someone able to see clearly, act after weighing, and speak with certainty.

nodes.label: Kural 635
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who knows righteousness, whose words are full and measured, and who knows at all times how to act, is a companion in counsel.

nodes.label: Kural 636
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What subtlety can stand before those who have sharp wit and book learning too?

nodes.label: Kural 637
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when you know the methods, know the nature of the world and then act.

nodes.label: Kural 638
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if he kills what others know and knows nothing himself, it is the duty of the one at his side to tell him what is good for him.

nodes.label: Kural 639
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Seven hundred million enemies are better than one minister at your side who plots harm.

nodes.label: Kural 640
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when they plan things in good order, those without skill in doing will leave them unfinished.

nodes.label: Kural 641
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To have the good called a good tongue is a good not found among any other goods.

nodes.label: Kural 642
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Gain and ruin both come from it, so guard carefully against any slip in your speech.

nodes.label: Kural 643
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Speech is that which holds its hearers fast, and is said so that even those who haven’t heard it long for it.

nodes.label: Kural 644
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Know the right way and speak your words. No righteousness and no wealth is greater than that.

nodes.label: Kural 645
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Say your word only when you know that no other word can beat it.

nodes.label: Kural 646
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To speak so that others want to hear, and to take what is useful from what others say, is the way of the flawless.

nodes.label: Kural 647
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man who speaks well, never slips and has no fear is hard for anyone to beat in a contest.

nodes.label: Kural 648
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world quickly does as it is asked, if it finds those who can speak in good order and sweetly.

nodes.label: Kural 649
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who don’t know how to say a few flawless words surely desire to say many.

nodes.label: Kural 650
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who can’t unfold what they have learned so that others grasp it are like flowers that bloom in clusters but have no scent.

nodes.label: Kural 651
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Good allies bring prosperity. Good deeds bring all you want.

nodes.label: Kural 652
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Always keep away from work that doesn’t bring good along with fame.

nodes.label: Kural 653
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who say “We will rise” must stop doing what dims their light.

nodes.label: Kural 654
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when they are in trouble, those of unshaken vision won’t do anything shameful.

nodes.label: Kural 655
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
