nodes.snippet: Don’t do what will make you cry “What have I done?” If you do, it is good not to do the like again.

nodes.label: Kural 656
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you see the mother who bore you go hungry, don’t do what the worthy condemn.

nodes.label: Kural 657
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Better the deep poverty of the worthy than prosperity gained by wearing disgrace.

nodes.label: Kural 658
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who do what is forbidden, not shunning what has been shunned, will find it brings pain even if it succeeds.

nodes.label: Kural 659
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All that was taken with tears leaves with tears. What is good, even if lost, bears fruit afterwards.

nodes.label: Kural 660
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Trying to stay safe on wealth made by deceit is like pouring water into a pot of raw clay and keeping it there.

nodes.label: Kural 661
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Firmness in action is a person’s firmness of mind. Everything else is something else.

nodes.label: Kural 662
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Avoiding harm, and not giving way once it comes: those who have looked into it say these two are the path.

nodes.label: Kural 663
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Real strength is to do the work so that it shows only at the end. If it shows midway, it brings trouble that won’t go.

nodes.label: Kural 664
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Saying it is easy for anyone. Doing it as you said is hard.

nodes.label: Kural 665
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The firmness in action of those who have risen to excellence reaches the ruler and is held in mind.

nodes.label: Kural 666
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who plan will get what they planned, just as they planned it, if they are firm.

nodes.label: Kural 667
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t scorn people for how they look. There are those who are the axle pin of the great rolling chariot.

nodes.label: Kural 668
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Once you have settled on a task with a clear mind, don’t waver or delay. Do it.

nodes.label: Kural 669
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if great pain comes, be resolute and do the work that brings joy.

nodes.label: Kural 670
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: However firm they are in other ways, the world doesn’t want those who don’t want firmness in action.

nodes.label: Kural 671
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The end of deliberation is to reach a decision. For that decision to sit in delay is wrong.

nodes.label: Kural 672
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Take your time over what should be done slowly. Don’t delay over what must be done without delay.

nodes.label: Kural 673
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Action is good wherever it is possible. Where it isn’t, look for the way that will work and do that.

nodes.label: Kural 674
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Think about it: what is left of a task or an enemy burns you as what is left of a fire does.

nodes.label: Kural 675
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Wealth, means, time, the work and the place: weigh all five until the darkness clears, then act.

nodes.label: Kural 676
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Look at the finish, the obstacles, and the gain you will reach when it is done, and then act.

nodes.label: Kural 677
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The way to do a task is this: take in the mind of someone who knows that task from the inside.

nodes.label: Kural 678
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To get one task done by means of another is to bind a wet-cheeked elephant with another elephant.

nodes.label: Kural 679
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Be quicker to win over those not with you than to do good to your friends.

nodes.label: Kural 680
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who hold little, fearing the trembling within, will bow to the great and take the terms, if they can get them.

nodes.label: Kural 681
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Loving-kindness, birth in a good family, and the qualities rulers desire: these are the qualities of an envoy.

nodes.label: Kural 682
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Loving-kindness, understanding and skill in well-weighed speech: envoys can’t do without these three.

nodes.label: Kural 683
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To be a master of the books among those who know the books: that is the quality of one who speaks for victory among men of the spear.

nodes.label: Kural 684
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Let the one who has all three, understanding, presence and well-tested learning, go on this work.

nodes.label: Kural 685
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An envoy sums up, drops what is harsh, speaks so that people smile, and brings about good.

nodes.label: Kural 686
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An envoy is learned, unafraid of a hard stare, speaks so that it goes home, and knows what suits the time.

nodes.label: Kural 687
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The finest is the one who knows his duty, watches the time, knows the place, thinks it through and then speaks.

nodes.label: Kural 688
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Purity, support and resolve, with truth alongside: these are the marks of one who carries a message.

nodes.label: Kural 689
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The one who delivers a message to rulers is a man of firm heart, whose mouth lets no scarring word slip.

nodes.label: Kural 690
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An envoy is one who, even if it brings his death, holds nothing back and brings about what is good for his ruler.

nodes.label: Kural 691
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who live close to quarrelsome rulers should be like people warming themselves at a fire, neither too far nor too near.

nodes.label: Kural 692
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Not wanting what rulers want will bring you lasting prosperity from those rulers.

nodes.label: Kural 693
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you guard yourself, guard against the grave faults. Once suspicion has set in, no one can easily clear it.

nodes.label: Kural 694
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In the presence of the truly great, put a stop to whispers in the ear and shared laughter.

nodes.label: Kural 695
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t listen in on anything, don’t press, and hear the secret when it is let out to you.

nodes.label: Kural 696
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Read the signs, consider the time, and say what is needed and not disliked, in a way that pleases.

nodes.label: Kural 697
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Say what is wanted. What is of no use, never say, even if asked.

nodes.label: Kural 698
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t scorn someone as young or as your kin. Live in keeping with the light that stands in them.

nodes.label: Kural 699
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those of steady vision won’t think “We have been accepted” and do what isn’t acceptable.

nodes.label: Kural 700
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The intimacy that says “We go back a long way” and does what isn’t fitting brings ruin.

nodes.label: Kural 701
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who can look and know what is meant, with nothing said, is an ornament to the world of unfailing waters.

nodes.label: Kural 702
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Hold anyone who knows without doubt what is in another’s heart as equal to a god.

nodes.label: Kural 703
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To gain those who can read a thought from its signs, give any of your limbs.

nodes.label: Kural 704
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who grasp a thought unspoken match other people limb for limb, yet they are different.

nodes.label: Kural 705
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If eyes can’t read a thought from its signs, what use are they among the body’s parts?

nodes.label: Kural 706
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: As crystal shows what lies beside it, the face shows what is strongest in the heart.

nodes.label: Kural 707
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Is there anything wiser than the face? In gladness or in anger, it gets there first.

nodes.label: Kural 708
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you have someone who can look within and know what has happened to you, it is enough to stand and look at their face.

nodes.label: Kural 709
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The eyes themselves will tell enmity and friendship, if you have those who know the ways of the eye.

nodes.label: Kural 710
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Look into it, and those who call themselves subtle have no measuring rod but the eye.

nodes.label: Kural 711
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those pure in speech, who know the range of words, should know the assembly, weigh it up, and then speak.

nodes.label: Kural 712
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those good at the ways of words should judge the moment, understand it well, and then speak.

nodes.label: Kural 713
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who take on speaking without knowing the assembly don’t know the kinds of speech, and have no skill at all.

nodes.label: Kural 714
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Be bright before the bright. Before the blank, take on the colour of white lime.

nodes.label: Kural 715
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Better even than all that is called good is the restraint of not speaking first among elders.

nodes.label: Kural 716
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Stumbling before those who have taken in wide learning is like losing your footing on the path.

nodes.label: Kural 717
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The learning of the well-read shines among those who can weigh words without fault.

nodes.label: Kural 718
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To speak before those with understanding is like pouring water on a bed where something is already growing.

nodes.label: Kural 719
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you can speak so that a good assembly takes it in, don’t speak in a petty one, even by forgetting.

nodes.label: Kural 720
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Speaking before those not of your own kind is like ambrosia spilled in a filthy yard.

nodes.label: Kural 721
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those pure in speech, who know the range of words, know the kinds of assembly and don’t slip before an able one.

nodes.label: Kural 722
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who can say what they have learned so that the learned take it in are called the learned among the learned.

nodes.label: Kural 723
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who die among the enemy are common. Those who have no fear in an assembly are rare.

nodes.label: Kural 724
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Say what you have learned so that the learned take it in, and from those who have learned more, take that more.

nodes.label: Kural 725
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Learn by the right path and know the measure, so that you can answer in an assembly without fear.

nodes.label: Kural 726
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What has a sword to do with those who lack hard courage? What have books to do with those who fear a subtle assembly?

nodes.label: Kural 727
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The learning of a man who fears the assembly is a bright sword in a eunuch’s hand among the enemy.

nodes.label: Kural 728
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who can’t speak so that a good assembly takes it in are of no use, however much they have learned.

nodes.label: Kural 729
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say those who have learned and understood, yet fear an assembly of the good, are lower than the unlearned.

nodes.label: Kural 730
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who fear the assembly and can’t get across what they have learned are alive, yet they are like those who are not.

nodes.label: Kural 731
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A country is where unfailing harvests, worthy people and the rich who never decline all come together.

nodes.label: Kural 732
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A country is a land desired for its great wealth, which yields abundantly because ruin rarely touches it.

nodes.label: Kural 733
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A country bears every burden that falls on it at once, and still gives its ruler his whole tax.

nodes.label: Kural 734
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A country runs free of deep hunger, endless sickness and destroying enemies.

nodes.label: Kural 735
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A country has no rival factions, no ruinous enemies within and no murderous rebels who harry the ruler.

nodes.label: Kural 736
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The land that knows no ruin, and whose riches hold even when it is ruined, is called the first of countries.

nodes.label: Kural 737
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The two waters, a well-placed hill, running water and a strong fortress are the limbs of a country.

nodes.label: Kural 738
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say five things are a country’s ornament: freedom from sickness, wealth, harvest, happiness and safety.

nodes.label: Kural 739
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A country is a land whose riches come without seeking. Land that gives riches only when sought is no country.

nodes.label: Kural 740
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even with all of this, a country is of no use if it isn’t well matched with its ruler.

nodes.label: Kural 741
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fortress is of value to those who are strong, and of value to those who fear and look after themselves.

nodes.label: Kural 742
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fortress has water bright as a gem, open ground, a hill, and a forest of fine shade.

nodes.label: Kural 743
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Height, breadth, strength and being hard to reach: the books say a fortress is what has all four.

nodes.label: Kural 744
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fortress needs little guarding, has ample room, and crushes the spirit of the enemy that reaches it.

nodes.label: Kural 745
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fortress is hard to take, holds stores of food, and is easy for those inside to hold.

nodes.label: Kural 746
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fortress has everything it needs, and good people who help when the moment comes.

nodes.label: Kural 747
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fortress is hard to take, whether by encircling it, by attacking without encircling, or by working treachery within.

nodes.label: Kural 748
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fortress is one where those holding it can hold fast and beat even those strong enough to surround it.

nodes.label: Kural 749
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An excellent fortress wins glory in action, and the enemy falls at the very front of the fight.

nodes.label: Kural 750
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: However excellent a fortress may be, with those who have no excellence in action it is no fortress.

nodes.label: Kural 751
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Nothing counts but wealth, which makes people who don’t count into people who do.

nodes.label: Kural 752
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Everyone scorns those who have nothing. Everyone honours the rich.

nodes.label: Kural 753
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The unfailing lamp called wealth goes to whatever land you think of and cuts through the dark.

nodes.label: Kural 754
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Wealth that comes by knowing how, and without wrong, gives birth to righteousness and to happiness.

nodes.label: Kural 755
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Wealth that comes without compassion and loving-kindness: don’t embrace it, let it roll away.

nodes.label: Kural 756
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Wealth that comes to him unbidden, customs dues, and wealth from crushing his enemies: these are a ruler’s wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 757
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Compassion, the child that loving-kindness bears, thrives with the rich foster-mother called wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 758
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Taking on a task with wealth in your hands is like watching elephants fight from the top of a hill.

nodes.label: Kural 759
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Make wealth. There is no steel sharper for cutting your enemies’ pride.

nodes.label: Kural 760
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who have made bright wealth in plenty, the other two come easily, and together.

nodes.label: Kural 761
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A complete army that fears no wound and wins is the first of all a ruler’s riches.

nodes.label: Kural 762
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The hard courage that fears no wound when the fight goes badly, even when the force is worn down, is rare except in an old army.

nodes.label: Kural 763
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What if a host of rats roars like the sea? A cobra breathes, and they are gone.

nodes.label: Kural 764
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An army is what doesn’t fall, can’t be turned by treachery, and has hard courage handed down.

nodes.label: Kural 765
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An army is what has the strength to stand together and face even Death, coming on in rage.

nodes.label: Kural 766
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Valour, honour, walking the noble path and clarity of mind: these four alone protect an army.

nodes.label: Kural 767
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An army knows how to bear the battle that comes at it, holds back the vanguard and goes forward.

nodes.label: Kural 768
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even without the power to strike or the strength to hold, an army gains greatness from how it looks.

nodes.label: Kural 769
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An army wins if it has no shrinking, no grudge that won’t go, and no poverty.

nodes.label: Kural 770
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: An army may have plenty of steadfast men, but without leaders it is no army.

nodes.label: Kural 771
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Enemies, don’t stand before my lord. Many have stood before him, and now they stand in stone.

nodes.label: Kural 772
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Better to hold a spear that missed an elephant than an arrow that hit a hare in the woods.

nodes.label: Kural 773
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They call fierce courage great manhood. When someone falls on hard times, generosity is the sharp edge of it.

nodes.label: Kural 774
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He lets the spear in his hand go with an elephant and comes on. He sees one in his own body, pulls it out and laughs.

nodes.label: Kural 775
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If a glaring eye blinks when a spear is thrown at it, isn’t that running away, for those with hard courage?

nodes.label: Kural 776
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He counts over his days and sets down every day with no noble wound as a day that slipped away.

nodes.label: Kural 777
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who want fame that circles the world and don’t want life: on them the warrior’s anklet has the grace of an ornament.

nodes.label: Kural 778
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Warriors who don’t fear for their lives when the fight comes keep their excellence, even if the ruler is angry with them.

nodes.label: Kural 779
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who die rather than go back on their vow: who can punish them for having failed?

nodes.label: Kural 780
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you can die so that the eyes of those who cared for you fill with tears, that death is worth begging for.

nodes.label: Kural 781
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is as hard to make as friendship? What guard is as hard to get past?

nodes.label: Kural 782
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The friendship of the worthy fills out like the new moon. The friendship of fools wanes like the moon after the full.

nodes.label: Kural 783
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A bond with people of good character is like a book: each time you return to it, it delights you more.

nodes.label: Kural 784
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You make friends not to laugh together but to step in and rebuke when someone goes too far.

nodes.label: Kural 785
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: There is no need to meet or spend time together. Feeling alone gives the bond of friendship.

nodes.label: Kural 786
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Friendship that makes the face smile is not friendship. Friendship makes the heart smile deep within.

nodes.label: Kural 787
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Friendship turns you from what would ruin you, sets you on the path, and shares the pain when ruin comes.

nodes.label: Kural 788
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Like the hand of someone whose clothes slip, friendship takes away trouble on the spot.

nodes.label: Kural 789
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Where does friendship sit enthroned? In standing firm, without wavering, and holding you up in every way it can.

nodes.label: Kural 790
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: “They are this much to us, and we are this much to them.” Say it, however finely, and the friendship looks poor.

nodes.label: Kural 791
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Nothing ruins you like making friends without looking into them. For those who hold to friendship, once made there is no leaving it.

nodes.label: Kural 792
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who makes a friend without looking and looking again ends in a sorrow that kills him.

nodes.label: Kural 793
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Know a person’s character, family, faults and the unfailing kin around them, then make them your friend.

nodes.label: Kural 794
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone well-born, who shrinks from blame upon himself: win his friendship, even if you have to pay for it.

nodes.label: Kural 795
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Choose with care friends who, when you go wrong, can speak until you weep, rebuke you, and make you see the right way.

nodes.label: Kural 796
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even in ruin there is one benefit: it is a rod that measures your people to their full length.

nodes.label: Kural 797
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What counts as gain for a person is to give up the friendship of fools and get clear of them.

nodes.label: Kural 798
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t think of things that make your spirit small. Don’t take the friendship of those who cut away your strength in trouble.

nodes.label: Kural 799
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The friendship of those who desert you in your ruin burns the heart, even if you think of it when death is upon you.

nodes.label: Kural 800
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Cling to the friendship of the spotless. Give something if you must, and leave the friendship of those who don’t fit.

nodes.label: Kural 801
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is old friendship? It is friendship that in no way cuts back the rights of closeness.

nodes.label: Kural 802
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The rights of closeness are a limb of friendship. To be its salt is the duty of the worthy.

nodes.label: Kural 803
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What use is long friendship if you can’t accept what a friend does by right, as if you had done it yourself?

nodes.label: Kural 804
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When friends, out of closeness, act without asking, people welcome it as something to be wished for.

nodes.label: Kural 805
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If friends do something that hurts, put it down to foolishness or to great closeness.

nodes.label: Kural 806
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who keep to the bounds of friendship don’t leave those who have stood by them from of old, even in ruin.

nodes.label: Kural 807
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if friends do what ruins them, those whose bond has come down through loving-kindness don’t lose their loving-kindness.

nodes.label: Kural 808
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those so close that they won’t hear of a friend’s fault, the day the friend does wrong is a good day.

nodes.label: Kural 809
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world desires those who don’t give up the friendship of those whose bond has come down unbroken.

nodes.label: Kural 810
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who don’t part from their good nature towards old friends are desired even by those who don’t desire them.

nodes.label: Kural 811
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if they seem ready to drink you up, the friendship of people without character is better shrinking than growing.

nodes.label: Kural 812
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who don’t fit, who make friends when it pays and leave when it doesn’t: what does it matter if you gain or lose them?

nodes.label: Kural 813
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Friends who weigh what they stand to gain, those who take what they are paid, and thieves are all alike.

nodes.label: Kural 814
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Better to be alone than to call your own those who are like an untaught horse that fails you in battle.

nodes.label: Kural 815
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The shabby friendship of small people, who give no protection even when you have made it, is better not had than had.

nodes.label: Kural 816
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The enmity of the wise is worth ten million times the deepest friendship of a fool.

nodes.label: Kural 817
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What enemies bring is a hundred million times better than a friendship that is only laughter.

nodes.label: Kural 818
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: With those who spoil work that could be done, say nothing, and let the friendship slowly slip away.

nodes.label: Kural 819
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The friendship of those whose acts are one thing and words another is bitter even in a dream.

nodes.label: Kural 820
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t let the friendship of those who are warm at home and blame you in the assembly come near you at all.

nodes.label: Kural 821
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The friendship of those who keep company without agreeing at heart is an anvil. When they find their chance, you are struck on it.

nodes.label: Kural 822
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The friendship of those who seem your own but are not will change, like the minds of women.

nodes.label: Kural 823
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even after learning many good things, it is hard for enemies to become good at heart.

nodes.label: Kural 824
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Fear the deceivers who smile sweetly with the face and are bitter within.

nodes.label: Kural 825
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who don’t join you in their minds are not to be trusted in anything, on their words alone.

nodes.label: Kural 826
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They may say good things, as friends do, but the words of those who aren’t with you are soon seen for what they are.

nodes.label: Kural 827
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t trust the bowing words of enemies. The bowing of a bow means harm.

nodes.label: Kural 828
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A weapon hides in the joined hands of enemies, and in their tears too.

nodes.label: Kural 829
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who make much of you and despise you: make them laugh, and within that friendship hold them so that it dies.

nodes.label: Kural 830
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When the time comes for an enemy to be a friend, be friends with the face, and put friendship out of the heart.

nodes.label: Kural 831
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is folly? It is taking hold of what harms you and letting go of what profits you.

nodes.label: Kural 832
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The worst folly of all is setting your heart on conduct that isn’t for you.

nodes.label: Kural 833
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Having no shame, looking into nothing, showing no warmth, caring for nothing: these are a fool’s habits.

nodes.label: Kural 834
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: No one is a greater fool than someone who studies, understands, teaches others, and still has no self-control.

nodes.label: Kural 835
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In a single birth, a fool can do enough to sink into the mire of hell for all seven births.

nodes.label: Kural 836
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a fool who doesn’t know how takes on a task, the task falls apart and the fool ends up in fetters.

nodes.label: Kural 837
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a fool comes into great wealth, strangers eat their fill and the fool’s own people go hungry.

nodes.label: Kural 838
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a fool gets something of their own in hand, it is like a madman getting drunk.

nodes.label: Kural 839
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The friendship of fools is very sweet. When it ends, it brings no pain at all.

nodes.label: Kural 840
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fool walking into a gathering of the worthy is like putting an unwashed foot on a bed.

nodes.label: Kural 841
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The worst poverty is a lack of understanding. The world does not count any other lack as poverty.

nodes.label: Kural 842
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When someone without understanding gives with a glad heart, it comes from nothing but the penance of the one who receives.

nodes.label: Kural 843
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The pain that people without understanding cause themselves is hard even for their enemies to cause.

nodes.label: Kural 844
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is called immaturity? It is the conceit that says, “I am wise.”

nodes.label: Kural 845
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Claiming to know what you have not learned makes people doubt even what you have truly mastered.

nodes.label: Kural 846
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you leave your own faults uncovered, covering your nakedness is just petty understanding.

nodes.label: Kural 847
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone without understanding who lets a precious secret slip does himself great harm.

nodes.label: Kural 848
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He won’t act when told and can’t work it out himself. Until that life leaves him, he is a disease.

nodes.label: Kural 849
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whoever tries to show a man who can’t see ends up seeing nothing himself. That man goes on seeing it the way he saw it.

nodes.label: Kural 850
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who says “there is none” where the world says “there is” will be counted a demon on this earth.

nodes.label: Kural 851
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They call strife the disease that feeds, in every living being, the fault of drawing apart.

nodes.label: Kural 852
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if someone means to break with you and does what you can’t bear, it is best not to answer with harm out of strife.

nodes.label: Kural 853
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Get rid of the painful disease called strife, and you gain an undying, spotless brightness.

nodes.label: Kural 854
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When strife, the worst pain of all pains, is gone, it brings the greatest joy of all joys.

nodes.label: Kural 855
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Who would try to get the better of those who can turn aside from strife?

nodes.label: Kural 856
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who calls it sweet to press on in strife will soon see his life falter and fall to ruin.

nodes.label: Kural 857
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People of bitter understanding who cling to strife can’t see the truth that brings victory.

nodes.label: Kural 858
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Turning aside from strife brings gain. Press on with it, and ruin presses on towards you.

nodes.label: Kural 859
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When gain is coming to him, a man doesn’t look for strife. To bring about his own ruin, he looks to increase it.

nodes.label: Kural 860
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Strife brings all that is bitter. Smiles bring the pride of true goodness.

nodes.label: Kural 861
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Keep from opposing the strong. Without holding back, seek enmity with the weak.

nodes.label: Kural 862
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He has no loving-kindness, no strong allies and no strength of his own. How can he wear down an enemy’s might?

nodes.label: Kural 863
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He fears, he doesn’t understand, he can’t get along with others, and he won’t give. His enemies will find him very easy.

nodes.label: Kural 864
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He doesn’t give up anger and has no self-command. Anyone, anywhere, at any time, finds him easy.

nodes.label: Kural 865
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He doesn’t look to the right way, doesn’t do what works, doesn’t mind blame, and has no good nature. His enemies find him sweet.

nodes.label: Kural 866
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man of blinding anger and overflowing desire: his enmity is worth wanting.

nodes.label: Kural 867
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you must pay for it, be sure to get the enmity of a man who stays at a task and does it all wrong.

nodes.label: Kural 868
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man with no virtues and many faults has no allies, and that is a safeguard for his enemies.

nodes.label: Kural 869
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who strike, joy is never far away when the enemy they get has no understanding and is full of fear.

nodes.label: Kural 870
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you won’t take the small prize of fighting an unlearned man, glory will never come to you.

nodes.label: Kural 871
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Enmity is a graceless thing. No one should want it, even in jest.

nodes.label: Kural 872
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you make enemies of ploughmen whose plough is the bow, don’t make enemies of ploughmen whose plough is the word.

nodes.label: Kural 873
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man who stands alone and makes enemies of many is more foolish than the mad.

nodes.label: Kural 874
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world rests in the greatness of one whose nature is to make friends of enemies.

nodes.label: Kural 875
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You have no ally, you have two enemies, and you are alone. Make one of the two your good ally.

nodes.label: Kural 876
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Whether you have trusted him or not, in a time of ruin neither join with him nor break from him. Leave him be.

nodes.label: Kural 877
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t tell your pain to those who don’t already know it. Don’t show weakness to your enemies.

nodes.label: Kural 878
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Know the way, build yourself up and guard yourself, and your enemies’ pride will die.

nodes.label: Kural 879
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Kill a thorn tree while it is young. Once it has hardened, it will kill the hand that cuts it.

nodes.label: Kural 880
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who fail to crush the pride of their foes surely won’t live even to draw breath.

nodes.label: Kural 881
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Shade and water are bad for you if they do harm. Your own people’s ways are bad too, if they do you harm.

nodes.label: Kural 882
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t fear enemies who are like swords. Fear the company of enemies who are like kin.

nodes.label: Kural 883
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Fear the enemy within and guard yourself. In your moment of weakness it will slice through you like the tool that cuts a potter’s clay.

nodes.label: Kural 884
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When an enemy within appears, unsound at heart, it brings many harms that turn your own people bad.

nodes.label: Kural 885
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When an enemy within appears who is close by kinship, it brings many harms that lead towards death.

nodes.label: Kural 886
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If discord arises among those close to you, it is always hard to escape death.

nodes.label: Kural 887
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Like a casket and its lid, a family with an enemy within may seem to fit together, but it never joins.

nodes.label: Kural 888
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Like gold rubbed by a file, a family with an enemy within wears away its strength.

nodes.label: Kural 889
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The enemy within may be as small as a split sesame seed, yet ruin lies inside it.

nodes.label: Kural 890
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Living with those who are not of one mind with you is like sharing a hut with a snake.

nodes.label: Kural 891
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Of all the ways to keep yourself safe, the first is not to scorn the power of those who can get things done.

nodes.label: Kural 892
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Live without respect for the great, and it will bring you lasting pain through the great.

nodes.label: Kural 893
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you want your ruin, don’t listen: offend those who can kill the moment they wish.

nodes.label: Kural 894
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For the powerless to harm the powerful is like beckoning Death with your hand.

nodes.label: Kural 895
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Go where they may, those who draw the anger of a fiercely strong ruler will live nowhere.

nodes.label: Kural 896
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You may survive being burned by fire. Those who offend the great will not survive.

nodes.label: Kural 897
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What becomes of a splendid life and vast wealth, if the truly worthy turn in anger on you?

nodes.label: Kural 898
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When those who are like mountains wish someone’s fall, people who seemed fixed on the earth vanish, with their families.

nodes.label: Kural 899
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When those of lofty vows flare up, even a ruler breaks midway and loses his rule.

nodes.label: Kural 900
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even those with the greatest of supports won’t survive if those of surpassing worth turn on them in anger.

nodes.label: Kural 901
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Men who dote on their wives won’t win the finest reward. Men who are set on action want no part of that.

nodes.label: Kural 902
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The gains of a man who craves a woman, careless of all else, become a great disgrace and bring him shame.

nodes.label: Kural 903
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The unnatural habit of bowing to your wife will always bring you shame among good people.

nodes.label: Kural 904
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man who fears his wife has nothing for the next life, and his skill at work wins him no glory.

nodes.label: Kural 905
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man who fears his wife will always be afraid to do good to good people.

nodes.label: Kural 906
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Though they live like the unblinking gods, men who fear their wives’ bamboo shoulders have no standing.

nodes.label: Kural 907
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A woman with modesty has more greatness than the manhood of a man who lives at a woman’s bidding.

nodes.label: Kural 908
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Men who live as a fair-browed woman wishes won’t meet their friends’ needs and won’t do good.

nodes.label: Kural 909
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Righteous acts, great wealth and other deeds are not found in those who do a woman’s bidding.

nodes.label: Kural 910
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those with a broad, thinking heart never have the folly that comes of clinging to a woman.

nodes.label: Kural 911
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The sweet words of women in fine bangles, who want wealth and not love, will bring you down.

nodes.label: Kural 912
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Women without virtue weigh what they can get and talk of their virtue. Weigh their ways and keep away.

nodes.label: Kural 913
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The false embrace of women who want only wealth is like embracing a stranger’s corpse in a dark room.

nodes.label: Kural 914
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those whose understanding looks to compassion won’t touch the cheap charms of women who look only to wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 915
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those whose understanding is made great by a good mind won’t touch the cheap charms of women who are common to all.

nodes.label: Kural 916
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who spread their own goodness won’t touch the shoulders of women who, proud of their looks, spread their cheap charms about.

nodes.label: Kural 917
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those without a steady heart will touch the shoulders of women who join their bodies while their hearts want something else.

nodes.label: Kural 918
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say that to those without sharp understanding, the embrace of deceitful women is a deadly spirit’s touch.

nodes.label: Kural 919
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The soft shoulders of finely jewelled women who draw no line are the mire of hell where worthless low men sink.

nodes.label: Kural 920
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Women of two hearts, liquor and dice are the friends of those whom prosperity has left.

nodes.label: Kural 921
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who live in love with liquor are never feared, and they lose their glory.

nodes.label: Kural 922
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t drink liquor. If anyone must, let it be those who don’t care to be counted by the worthy.

nodes.label: Kural 923
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Being drunk is hateful even in your mother’s sight. What must it be in the sight of the worthy?

nodes.label: Kural 924
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The good woman called Shame turns her back on those guilty of the great, despised fault called liquor.

nodes.label: Kural 925
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Paying out your wealth to buy senselessness shows you don’t know what to do.

nodes.label: Kural 926
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People asleep are no different from the dead. People who drink liquor are always drinking poison.

nodes.label: Kural 927
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who drink in secret till their eyes droop will always be laughed at by their townsfolk, who see right through them.

nodes.label: Kural 928
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Give up saying, “I have never been drunk.” What you hid in your heart will only show the more, then and there.

nodes.label: Kural 929
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Reasoning with a drunk is like taking a lamp to look for someone who has dived under water.

nodes.label: Kural 930
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When a drinker, sober for the moment, sees a drunk man, doesn’t he think of how he slips when he has drunk?

nodes.label: Kural 931
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Don’t want gambling, even if you win. Your winnings are a hook swallowed by a fish.

nodes.label: Kural 932
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Gamblers gain one and lose a hundred. Can they have any way to gain good and live?

nodes.label: Kural 933
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Keep on calling the throws of the rolling dice, and your wealth and income will leave and go to others.

nodes.label: Kural 934
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Nothing brings poverty like gambling, which shrinks you in many ways and ruins your good name.

nodes.label: Kural 935
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who cling in their pride to dice, gaming hall and skill of hand have come to nothing.

nodes.label: Kural 936
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those covered over by the goddess of misfortune called gambling won’t fill their bellies, and will suffer.

nodes.label: Kural 937
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If your time goes into the gaming hall, it destroys the wealth and good nature you have long had.

nodes.label: Kural 938
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Gambling destroys your wealth, makes you take up lying, destroys your compassion, and leaves you to suffer.

nodes.label: Kural 939
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Clothes, wealth, food, glory and learning: these five won’t come near you if you take to dice.

nodes.label: Kural 940
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: As gambling is loved more with each loss, so the soul loves more with each pain.

nodes.label: Kural 941
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Too much or too little, and the three the learned list, starting with wind, will cause disease.

nodes.label: Kural 942
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The body needs nothing called medicine if you eat only after making sure that what you ate has been digested.

nodes.label: Kural 943
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When your food has been digested, eat knowing the measure. That is how someone who has a body makes it last.

nodes.label: Kural 944
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Know that your food is digested, get properly hungry, and take care to eat only what doesn’t disagree with you.

nodes.label: Kural 945
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Eat food that doesn’t disagree with you, and stop short, and your life will come to no harm.

nodes.label: Kural 946
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Joy stays with someone who knows to eat a little less. In the same way, disease stays with someone who gorges.

nodes.label: Kural 947
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Someone who eats without thought, more than the fire can take, will have diseases without measure.

nodes.label: Kural 948
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Find the disease, find its cause, find the way to ease it, and act so that it works.

nodes.label: Kural 949
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The one who has learned should weigh the patient, the disease and the time, and then act.

nodes.label: Kural 950
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The patient, the healer, the remedy and the attendant: medicine has these four parts.

nodes.label: Kural 951
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Only in those born of a good family do uprightness and shame come together by nature.

nodes.label: Kural 952
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those of good family never slip from these three: good conduct, truth and shame.

nodes.label: Kural 953
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A smile, giving, sweet words and scorning no one: they say these four belong to a true family.

nodes.label: Kural 954
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even for piled-up millions, those of good family won’t do anything that lowers them.

nodes.label: Kural 955
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even when what they have to give has shrunk, those of an old family don’t part from their good nature.

nodes.label: Kural 956
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who say, “We will live by our spotless family,” won’t turn to deceit and do unworthy things.

nodes.label: Kural 957
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A fault in those of good family stands out like the spot on the moon in the sky.

nodes.label: Kural 958
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If a lack of warmth shows in someone of good character, people will doubt his family.

nodes.label: Kural 959
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A sprout shows what the soil is like. The words from a person’s mouth show what their family is like.

nodes.label: Kural 960
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you want goodness, have shame. If you want a good family name, bow to everyone.

nodes.label: Kural 961
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even things you can’t do without, give them up if they would lower you.

nodes.label: Kural 962
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who want glory along with great strength of character won’t do anything unworthy, even for glory.

nodes.label: Kural 963
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In plenty, bow low. When your means shrink, stand tall.

nodes.label: Kural 964
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People who fall from their standing are like hair fallen from the head.

nodes.label: Kural 965
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People as high as a hill will still fall if they do something low, even a thing the size of a crab’s-eye seed.

nodes.label: Kural 966
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: It brings no fame and it won’t take you to the land of the gods. So why follow behind those who despise you?

nodes.label: Kural 967
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Better to be called ruined there and then than to live by trailing after those who spurn you.

nodes.label: Kural 968
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When your great dignity is being destroyed, is a life of tending your flesh any medicine?

nodes.label: Kural 969
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Like the yak that won’t live if it loses its hair, there are those who give up their life when honour demands it.

nodes.label: Kural 970
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world bows down and praises the radiance of those whose honour won’t let them live on in disgrace.

nodes.label: Kural 971
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A person’s light is a wealth of spirit. A person’s disgrace is to say, “I can live without that.”

nodes.label: Kural 972
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Birth is the same for every living being. Distinction is not, because what they do is different.

nodes.label: Kural 973
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who aren’t high aren’t high, even sitting high. Those who aren’t low aren’t low, even sitting low.

nodes.label: Kural 974
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: As with women of undivided heart, greatness too comes only if you guard yourself.

nodes.label: Kural 975
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The great will carry out hard deeds, and by the right means.

nodes.label: Kural 976
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: It never enters the minds of the small to say, “We will honour the great and hold on to them.”

nodes.label: Kural 977
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even distinction, when it falls to the unworthy, turns to nothing but excess.

nodes.label: Kural 978
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Greatness always bends low. Smallness admires itself and dresses itself up.

nodes.label: Kural 979
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Greatness is having no pride. Smallness is riding on pride, all the way to its limit.

nodes.label: Kural 980
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Greatness hides another’s shame. Smallness speaks of nothing but faults.

nodes.label: Kural 981
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say every good thing is a duty for those who know what is due and take up worth.

nodes.label: Kural 982
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The goodness of the worthy is goodness of character. No other goodness counts as goodness at all.

nodes.label: Kural 983
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Loving-kindness, a sense of shame, helpfulness, considerateness and truthfulness are the five pillars that hold up worth.

nodes.label: Kural 984
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The good of penance lies in not killing. The good of worth lies in not speaking of others’ wrongs.

nodes.label: Kural 985
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The strength of the capable is bowing. That is the weapon the worthy use to turn enemies around.

nodes.label: Kural 986
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What is the touchstone of worth? Accepting defeat, even from those who are not your equals.

nodes.label: Kural 987
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What use is worth, if you don’t do kindness even to those who have done you harm?

nodes.label: Kural 988
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Having nothing is no disgrace, if you have the strength called worth.

nodes.label: Kural 989
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if the age itself shifts, those called the ocean of worth will not shift.

nodes.label: Kural 990
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If the worthy fall from their worth, even the great earth can’t bear its load.

nodes.label: Kural 991
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: They say that being easy to approach, for anyone at all, makes the way of courtesy easy to reach.

nodes.label: Kural 992
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Having loving-kindness and being born into a good family: these two are the way of courtesy.

nodes.label: Kural 993
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Having the same limbs does not make people alike. True likeness is likeness in the courtesy that draws people close.

nodes.label: Kural 994
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world praises the courtesy of those who are useful because they care for justice and for doing good.

nodes.label: Kural 995
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Scorn hurts, even in fun. Those who know what others feel stay courteous, even in enmity.

nodes.label: Kural 996
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world goes on because of the courteous. Without them it would sink into the earth and die.

nodes.label: Kural 997
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those without human courtesy are like trees, even if they are as sharp as a file.

nodes.label: Kural 998
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even towards those who won’t be friends and treat you unkindly, it is low to fail in courtesy.

nodes.label: Kural 999
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: To those who can’t laugh, the vast wide world lies in darkness, even by day.

nodes.label: Kural 1000
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The great wealth gained by someone without courtesy is like good milk gone sour from a bad pot.

nodes.label: Kural 1001
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: He stores up great heaps of wealth and doesn’t eat from it. He is a dead man, and there is nothing he can do with it.

nodes.label: Kural 1002
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: “Wealth brings everything,” you think, and you clutch it and give nothing. That delusion brings a wretched birth.

nodes.label: Kural 1003
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Men who crave piling up wealth and don’t want fame are only a load on the earth.

nodes.label: Kural 1004
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What does he think he will leave behind, this man whom no one wants?

nodes.label: Kural 1005
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: People who neither give nor enjoy have nothing, even with ten million heaped on ten million.

nodes.label: Kural 1006
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man who won’t enjoy it himself and has no habit of giving to the deserving is a sickness to great wealth.

nodes.label: Kural 1007
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wealth of a man who gives nothing to those who have nothing is like a woman of great beauty growing old alone.

nodes.label: Kural 1008
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The wealth of a man no one wants is like a poison tree bearing fruit in the middle of the village.

nodes.label: Kural 1009
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You give up loving-kindness, punish yourself and ignore righteousness to gather bright wealth, and others take it.

nodes.label: Kural 1010
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A short spell of hardship for the wealthy of good name is like a rain cloud running dry.

nodes.label: Kural 1011
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Real shame is shrinking from an act. The rest is the shyness of good women with lovely foreheads.

nodes.label: Kural 1012
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Food, clothing and the rest are no different for anyone alive. What marks out a person is a sense of shame.

nodes.label: Kural 1013
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: All life is bound to flesh. Worth is bound to the good called shame.

nodes.label: Kural 1014
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Isn’t shame the ornament of the worthy? Without it, isn’t a proud walk a disease?

nodes.label: Kural 1015
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world calls those who are ashamed of others’ blame as well as their own the home of shame.

nodes.label: Kural 1016
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The best of people won’t want the wide world unless they have shame as their fence.

nodes.label: Kural 1017
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who live by shame will give up life for shame. They won’t give up shame for life.

nodes.label: Kural 1018
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If a man feels no shame at what would shame others, righteousness has reason to feel shame.

nodes.label: Kural 1019
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Failing in your principles burns your family’s name. Shamelessness, once it stays, burns all your good.

nodes.label: Kural 1020
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those with no shame inside them move like a wooden puppet, whose string fools you into thinking it is alive.

nodes.label: Kural 1021
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Nothing is more dignified than the greatness that says, “I won’t rest my hands from the work.”

nodes.label: Kural 1022
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A family grows through long work that has two things in it: effort and full understanding.

nodes.label: Kural 1023
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For anyone who says, “I will raise my family,” god tucks up its cloth and goes on ahead.

nodes.label: Kural 1024
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: For those who strive without delay for their family, success comes of itself, without planning.

nodes.label: Kural 1025
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world gathers round a man who raises his family and does no wrong, as if it were his kin.

nodes.label: Kural 1026
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The good kind of manliness is to make yourself master of the family you were born into.

nodes.label: Kural 1027
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: As the battlefield rests on the fearless, among your own people too the load falls on those who can carry it.

nodes.label: Kural 1028
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those raising a family have no season. Be idle and think of your pride, and it is ruined.

nodes.label: Kural 1029
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Is the body of the man who shields his family from harm only a vessel for suffering?

nodes.label: Kural 1030
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A family with no good person to stand by and prop it up will fall when trouble cuts it at the root.

nodes.label: Kural 1031
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The world may turn every way, but it still follows the plough. So for all its toil, ploughing comes first.

nodes.label: Kural 1032
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who plough are the linchpin of the world, because they carry all who can’t and go off to other work.

nodes.label: Kural 1033
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Only those who plough and eat really live. All the rest bow to eat, and walk behind others.

nodes.label: Kural 1034
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who have the shade of ripe grain will see the shade of many royal parasols come under their own.

nodes.label: Kural 1035
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Those who by nature eat by the work of their own hands won’t beg. They give to those who beg, and hide nothing.

nodes.label: Kural 1036
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If those who plough fold their hands, even those who say they have given up all desire can’t stand firm.

nodes.label: Kural 1037
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Let the ploughed earth dry until it weighs a quarter of what it did, and the crop will thrive with not a handful of manure.

nodes.label: Kural 1038
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Manuring does more good than ploughing. After weeding, guarding the crop does more good than watering.

nodes.label: Kural 1039
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If the owner doesn’t go to it and just stays put, the land will resent it and sulk like a wife.

nodes.label: Kural 1040
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When she sees people sitting idle, saying, “We have nothing,” the good woman called earth laughs.

nodes.label: Kural 1041
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What hurts like poverty? Only poverty hurts like poverty.

nodes.label: Kural 1042
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The sinner called poverty comes and leaves you with neither the next world nor this one.

nodes.label: Kural 1043
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The craving called poverty destroys, all at once, your old family standing and your fine speech.

nodes.label: Kural 1044
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even in those of good family, poverty brings a weakness from which shameful words are born.

nodes.label: Kural 1045
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: In the one misery called poverty, many miseries come and settle.

nodes.label: Kural 1046
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if they know a good truth well and say it, the words of the poor lose their meaning.

nodes.label: Kural 1047
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A man whose poverty has no righteousness to it is looked at as a stranger, even by the mother who bore him.

nodes.label: Kural 1048
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Will it come today too, the poverty that all but killed me yesterday?

nodes.label: Kural 1049
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: You can sleep even in the middle of a fire. In poverty there is no sleep at all.

nodes.label: Kural 1050
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If those who have nothing don’t give up everything, they are only the death of salt and gruel.

nodes.label: Kural 1051
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If you see someone it is right to beg from, beg. If they hide what they have, the blame is theirs, not yours.

nodes.label: Kural 1052
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Begging itself is a pleasure, if what you ask for comes without pain.

nodes.label: Kural 1053
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: There is a beauty even in begging, standing before those with no hiding in their hearts who know what is due.

nodes.label: Kural 1054
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Begging is like giving, when you beg from those who don’t know how to hide even in a dream.

nodes.label: Kural 1055
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: It is because there are people in the world who don’t hide what they have that some can stand before them and beg.

nodes.label: Kural 1056
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: See those free from the misery of hiding, and all the misery of poverty ends at once.

nodes.label: Kural 1057
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: On seeing those who give without scorn or insult, the heart is glad and rejoices deep within.

nodes.label: Kural 1058
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Without people who beg, this great cool world would be a wooden puppet going back and forth.

nodes.label: Kural 1059
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What glory would givers have, if there were none who want to beg and receive?

nodes.label: Kural 1060
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: A beggar should not get angry. The misery of his own poverty is witness enough.

nodes.label: Kural 1061
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even from those as dear as your eyes, who give gladly and hide nothing, not begging is worth ten million times more.

nodes.label: Kural 1062
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: If the one who made the world wanted people to live even by begging, let him wander far and perish.

nodes.label: Kural 1063
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Nothing is harder than the hardness that says, “I will end the misery of poverty by begging.”

nodes.label: Kural 1064
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even with no means left, the worth that won’t consent to beg is too great for all the space there is to hold.

nodes.label: Kural 1065
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if it is gruel as thin as water, nothing is sweeter than eating what your own labour has brought.

nodes.label: Kural 1066
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Even if you beg water for a cow, there is nothing more shaming to the tongue than begging.

nodes.label: Kural 1067
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: I beg of everyone who begs: if you must beg, don’t beg from those who hide what they have.

nodes.label: Kural 1068
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The unsafe boat called begging will split apart when it strikes the rock called hiding.

nodes.label: Kural 1069
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The heart melts at the thought of begging. At the thought of hiding, even what is left dies.

nodes.label: Kural 1070
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: At a mere word, the life goes out of those who beg. Where then does the life of those who hide go to hide?

nodes.label: Kural 1071
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The base look just like people. We have never seen a likeness like it.

nodes.label: Kural 1072
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The base are more fortunate than those who know what is good, for their hearts have no worries.

nodes.label: Kural 1073
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The base are like the gods, for they too do whatever they please.

nodes.label: Kural 1074
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When the low meet a lesser rogue, they outdo him and swagger.

nodes.label: Kural 1075
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: Fear is all the good conduct of the low. Apart from that, there is a little, if there is something they want.

nodes.label: Kural 1076
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The base are like a drum being beaten, because they carry the secrets they hear to others and tell them.

nodes.label: Kural 1077
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The base won’t shake off so much as their wet hands for anyone but those whose clenched fists can break their jaws.

nodes.label: Kural 1078
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: The worthy are of use at a word. The low, like sugarcane, are of use only when crushed.

nodes.label: Kural 1079
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: When the low see what others wear and eat, they can always find a fault in them.

nodes.label: Kural 1080
nodes.speaker: tiruvalluvar
nodes.snippet: What are the base good for? When something happens to them, they are fit to sell themselves, quickly.

nodes.label: Kural 1081
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: This one with the heavy earrings: is she a goddess, a rare peacock or a woman? My heart is lost in doubt.

nodes.label: Kural 1082
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: When she looks back at my look, it is as if a goddess who strikes had brought an army with her.

nodes.label: Kural 1083
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: I never knew before what they call death. Now I know. It has a woman’s ways and big, battling eyes.

nodes.label: Kural 1084
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Her eyes are at odds with this innocent, womanly girl. They look ready to eat the life of anyone who sees them.

nodes.label: Kural 1085
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Is it death? Is it an eye? Is it a doe? This innocent girl’s glance has all three in it.

nodes.label: Kural 1086
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: If her curved brows were straight and hid them, her eyes would not cause me this trembling pain.

nodes.label: Kural 1087
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The cloth over this woman’s firm breasts is like the cover over the eyes of a rutting elephant.

nodes.label: Kural 1088
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Oh, that bright forehead! My strength, feared in battle even by those who never faced me, has broken before it.

nodes.label: Kural 1089
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: She has the shy look of a doe, and modesty. What is the use of decking her with ornaments that are strangers to her?

nodes.label: Kural 1090
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Brewed liquor gives joy only to those who drink it. It can’t delight those who merely see, as desire does.

nodes.label: Kural 1091
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Her kohl-lined eyes hold two looks. One look brings sickness and the other is the medicine for it.

nodes.label: Kural 1092
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: That small glance her eyes steal at me isn’t just half of desire. It is far more.

nodes.label: Kural 1093
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: She looked, and having looked she bowed her head. That was water she poured on the bond between us.

nodes.label: Kural 1094
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: When I look at her, she looks at the ground. When I don’t, she looks at me and softly smiles.

nodes.label: Kural 1095
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: She won’t look straight at me, but that is all. As if narrowing one eye, she smiles.

nodes.label: Kural 1096
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: They may talk like strangers, but the words of those who aren’t truly hostile are soon seen through.

nodes.label: Kural 1097
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Small harsh words with no anger behind them, looks that seem hostile: these are the signs of people who are close but act like strangers.

nodes.label: Kural 1098
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: When I look, she softens and slowly smiles. There is a beauty then in this woman of swaying grace.

nodes.label: Kural 1099
nodes.speaker: friend
nodes.snippet: Looking at each other with a blank look, as strangers do, is found only among lovers.

nodes.label: Kural 1100
nodes.speaker: friend
nodes.snippet: When eyes and eyes agree in their look, the words of the mouth are no use at all.

nodes.label: Kural 1101
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: All that the five senses know, by seeing, hearing, tasting, smelling and touching, is here in her of the bright bangles.

nodes.label: Kural 1102
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The medicine for an illness is something else. For the sickness this jewelled woman gives, she herself is the medicine.

nodes.label: Kural 1103
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Is the world of the lotus-eyed one sweeter than sleep on the soft shoulders of the one you love?

nodes.label: Kural 1104
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: It burns when you move away and cools when you come near. Where did she get this fire?

nodes.label: Kural 1105
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The shoulders of this woman with flowers in her hair are like whatever you want, just when you want it.

nodes.label: Kural 1106
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Each time I touch her, my life puts out new leaves. This innocent girl’s shoulders must be made of ambrosia.

nodes.label: Kural 1107
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Embracing this woman of lovely complexion is like staying in your own home and eating your share of what is yours.

nodes.label: Kural 1108
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: For two who love each other, it is sweet: an embrace that not even the air can cut through.

nodes.label: Kural 1109
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Sulking, making up and coming together: these are what those who have joined in desire get from it.

nodes.label: Kural 1110
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Each thing you learn shows up your ignorance. Desire is like that, each time I hold this woman in red jewels close.

nodes.label: Kural 1111
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Long may you live, aṉiccam flower, you are the best of them. But the one I love is softer than you.

nodes.label: Kural 1112
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: My heart, when you see flowers you lose your wits, thinking her eyes are like blooms that everyone can see.

nodes.label: Kural 1113
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: This woman with bamboo shoulders: her skin is a young leaf, her smile is pearl, her scent is perfume, her kohl-lined eyes are spears.

nodes.label: Kural 1114
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: If the blue lily could see, it would bow its head and look at the ground, saying, “We can’t match the eyes of this woman in fine jewels.”

nodes.label: Kural 1115
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: She has put on aṉiccam flowers without pinching off the stems. No good drums will sound for her waist now.

nodes.label: Kural 1116
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Unable to tell the moon from this woman’s face, the stars have been thrown from their places.

nodes.label: Kural 1117
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Is there a spot on this woman’s face, as there is on the bright moon, filled again where it had wasted away?

nodes.label: Kural 1118
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Long may you live, moon. If you can shine like this woman’s face, you too can have my love.

nodes.label: Kural 1119
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Moon, if you want to match the face of this woman with eyes like flowers, don’t appear for all to see.

nodes.label: Kural 1120
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The aṉiccam flower and the swan’s down feel like thorny caltrop fruit to this woman’s feet.

nodes.label: Kural 1121
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The moisture that wells at the white teeth of this soft-spoken woman is like milk mixed with honey.

nodes.label: Kural 1122
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The bond between this woman and me is the bond between body and soul.

nodes.label: Kural 1123
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Little figure in the black of my eye, go away. There is no room for the woman I love, with her lovely forehead.

nodes.label: Kural 1124
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: This woman in choice jewels is life to the soul, and when she leaves, she is death to it.

nodes.label: Kural 1125
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: I would remember, if I ever forgot. But I don’t know how to forget the ways of this woman with her bright, warring eyes.

nodes.label: Kural 1126
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: My lover won’t leave my eyes, and when I blink it doesn’t hurt him. That is how subtle he is.

nodes.label: Kural 1127
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: My lover lives in my eyes, so I don’t even line them with kohl. I know he would be hidden.

nodes.label: Kural 1128
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: My lover lives in my heart, so I’m afraid to eat anything hot. I know he would burn.

nodes.label: Kural 1129
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: I know that if I blink he will be hidden. For just that, this town calls him a stranger.

nodes.label: Kural 1130
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: He lives happily in my heart, always. This town says he lives apart from me, a stranger.

nodes.label: Kural 1131
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: For those who suffer and ache with desire, there is no refuge and no strength but the palmyra stalk.

nodes.label: Kural 1132
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: My body and soul, which can’t bear this, will ride the palmyra stalk, putting shame aside.

nodes.label: Kural 1133
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Once I had shame and good manly strength. Today I have the palmyra stalk that people in desire ride.

nodes.label: Kural 1134
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The fierce flood of desire carries off the raft of shame and good manly strength.

nodes.label: Kural 1135
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: She of the small bangles strung like a garland gave me the palmyra stalk, and the sorrow that comes with the evening.

nodes.label: Kural 1136
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Even at midnight I think of riding the palmyra stalk. Because of this innocent girl my eyes won’t close.

nodes.label: Kural 1137
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Nothing is greater than a woman, who suffers desire as vast as the sea and still doesn’t ride the palmyra stalk.

nodes.label: Kural 1138
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: Desire doesn’t say, “They are too firm to overcome,” or “They deserve pity.” It breaks out of hiding into the open.

nodes.label: Kural 1139
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: Thinking that no one knows, my desire wanders the streets in a daze.

nodes.label: Kural 1140
nodes.speaker: she
nodes.snippet: Fools laugh in front of my eyes, because they haven’t suffered what I have.

nodes.label: Kural 1141
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: The gossip keeps my precious life going. By good fortune, most people don’t know that.

nodes.label: Kural 1142
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Not knowing how rare she is, this woman with eyes like flowers, this town has made me a gift of gossip.

nodes.label: Kural 1143
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Isn’t the gossip the town knows a good thing for me? It feels as if I have what I haven’t got.

nodes.label: Kural 1144
nodes.speaker: he
nodes.snippet: Gossip is what makes my desire grow. Without it, desire would lose its nature and shrink away.
